        "artifact_kind": "determinism_study",
        "study_id": f"m6-study-{canonical_sha256([schedule['schedule_sha256'], journal['journal_sha256'], seed, bootstrap_replicates])[:16]}",
        "generated_at_utc": generated_at_utc or _now(),
        "schedule_sha256": schedule["schedule_sha256"],
        "journal_sha256": journal["journal_sha256"],
        "source_identity_sha256": schedule["source_identity_sha256"],
        "config_identity_sha256": schedule["config_identity_sha256"],
        "metric_identity_sha256": schedule["metric_identity_sha256"],
        "m4_identity_sha256": schedule["m4_identity"]["identity_sha256"],
        "completion_state": completion,
        "taxonomy": list(DETERMINISM_CLASSES),
        "accounting": accounting,
        "trigger_decisions": decisions,
        "row_accounting": rows,
        "classifications": classifications,
        "out_of_range_rates": oor_rates,
        "noise_floors": noise_floors,
        "denominators": denominators,
        "protocol_sensitivity": sensitivity,
        "class_migrations": migrations,
        "analysis_policy": {
            "bootstrap_replicates": bootstrap_replicates,
            "bootstrap_seed": seed,
            "floor_quantile": 0.9,
            "floor_upper_confidence": 0.9,
            "within_session_only": True,
            "raw_values_clamped": False,
            "admitted_summary_consumed": False,
            "reference_oor_zero_confirmed": reference_oor_zero,
        },
    }
    analysis["analysis_sha256"] = canonical_sha256(analysis)
    _validate_schema("analysis", analysis, repo_root)
    return analysis


def _artifact_payload_record(payload: bytes) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"artifact_sha256": sha256_bytes(payload), "size_bytes": len(payload)}


def _artifact_file_record(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = _read_regular(path, role="artifact")
    return _artifact_payload_record(payload)


def build_done(
    schedule: Mapping[str, Any],
    journal: Mapping[str, Any],
    analysis: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    schedule_path: Path,
    journal_path: Path,
    analysis_path: Path,
    schedule_payload: bytes | None = None,
    journal_payload: bytes | None = None,
    analysis_payload: bytes | None = None,
    generated_at_utc: str | None = None,
    repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if analysis["completion_state"] != "complete":
        _fail("M6_DONE_INCOMPLETE", analysis["completion_state"])
    if journal["trigger_state"] != "decided":
        _fail("M6_DONE_TRIGGER_STATE", journal["trigger_state"])
    if schedule["m4_identity"]["status"] != "complete":
        _fail("M6_DONE_M4_INCOMPLETE", "complete M4 identity required")
    if analysis["accounting"]["denominator_scope"] != "complete_m4_launch_set":
        _fail("M6_DONE_DENOMINATOR_SCOPE", analysis["accounting"]["denominator_scope"])
    accounting = analysis["accounting"]
    selected_metric_keys = {
        metric["key"]
        for metric in schedule["metrics"]
        if metric["capture_status"] == "selected"
    }
    expected_bucket_keys = {
        (config["config_id"], metric_key)
        for config in schedule["configs"]
        for metric_key in selected_metric_keys
    }
    buckets = accounting.get("per_config_metric")
    actual_bucket_keys = {
        (bucket.get("config_id"), bucket.get("metric_key"))
        for bucket in buckets
        if isinstance(bucket, dict)
    } if isinstance(buckets, list) else set()
    nonvacuous = (
        accounting.get("active_slots", 0) > 0
        and accounting.get("observed_slots") == accounting.get("active_slots")
        and accounting.get("terminal_slots") == accounting.get("active_slots")
        and accounting.get("pending_slots") == 0
        and accounting.get("excluded_typed_slots") == 0
        and accounting.get("raw_rows_collected", 0) > 0
        and accounting.get("raw_rows_collected") == accounting.get("expected_rows")
        and accounting.get("not_collected_typed_rows") == 0
        and accounting.get("pending_expected_rows") == 0
        and accounting.get("classified_raw_rows", 0)
        + accounting.get("excluded_typed_raw_rows", 0)
        == accounting.get("raw_rows_collected")
        and isinstance(buckets, list)
        and len(buckets) == len(expected_bucket_keys)
        and actual_bucket_keys == expected_bucket_keys
        and all(
            bucket.get("expected_rows", 0) > 0
            and bucket.get("collected_rows") == bucket.get("expected_rows")
            and bucket.get("not_collected_typed_rows") == 0
            and bucket.get("pending_rows") == 0
            and bucket.get("classified_rows", 0)
            + bucket.get("excluded_typed_rows", 0)
            == bucket.get("collected_rows")
            for bucket in buckets
            if isinstance(bucket, dict)
        )
    )
    if not nonvacuous:
        _fail(
            "M6_DONE_NONVACUOUS_EVIDENCE",
            "every active slot and selected metric requires a retained observation",
        )
    if not analysis["analysis_policy"]["reference_oor_zero_confirmed"]:
        _fail("M6_DONE_REFERENCE_OOR", "host-locked reference has OOR observations")
    matrix_payload = _resolve_repo_file(
        schedule["source_identity"]["canonical_matrix"],
        repo_root,
        role="canonical matrix",
    )
    _validate_m4_identity(
        schedule["m4_identity"],
        matrix=loads_strict(matrix_payload, role="canonical matrix"),
        matrix_sha256=sha256_bytes(matrix_payload),
        cells=schedule["cells"],
        repo_root=repo_root,
        require_complete=True,
    )
    schemas = []
    for kind, path in SCHEMA_PATHS.items():
        actual = repo_root / path.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)
        payload = _read_regular(actual, role=f"{kind} schema")
        schemas.append({
            "schema_id": kind,
            "path": path.relative_to(REPO_ROOT).as_posix(),
            "sha256": sha256_bytes(payload),
        })
    schemas.sort(key=lambda row: row["schema_id"])
    schedule_record = (
        _artifact_payload_record(schedule_payload)
        if schedule_payload is not None
        else _artifact_file_record(schedule_path)
    )
    journal_record = (
        _artifact_payload_record(journal_payload)
        if journal_payload is not None
        else _artifact_file_record(journal_path)
    )
    analysis_record = (
        _artifact_payload_record(analysis_payload)
        if analysis_payload is not None
        else _artifact_file_record(analysis_path)
    )
    done = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "artifact_kind": "m6_determinism_done",
        "status": "done",
        "generated_at_utc": generated_at_utc or _now(),
        "schedule": schedule_record,
        "journal": journal_record,
        "analysis": {"relative_path": "determinism_study.json", **analysis_record},
        "schemas": schemas,
        "source_identity_sha256": schedule["source_identity_sha256"],
        "config_identity_sha256": schedule["config_identity_sha256"],
        "metric_identity_sha256": schedule["metric_identity_sha256"],
        "m4_identity_sha256": schedule["m4_identity"]["identity_sha256"],
        "m4_status": "complete",
        "counts": {
            "runnable_cells": EXPECTED_RUNNABLE,
            "configs": 6,
            "tier1_slots": TIER1_SLOTS,
            "triggered_cells": analysis["accounting"]["triggered_cells"],
            "tier2_slots": analysis["accounting"]["active_tier2_slots"],
            "total_slots": analysis["accounting"]["active_slots"],
            "raw_rows_collected": analysis["accounting"]["raw_rows_collected"],
            "classified_raw_rows": analysis["accounting"]["classified_raw_rows"],
            "excluded_typed_raw_rows": analysis["accounting"]["excluded_typed_raw_rows"],
            "not_collected_typed_rows": analysis["accounting"]["not_collected_typed_rows"],
        },
        "accounting_identity_holds": True,
        "denominator_identity_holds": True,
        "taxonomy": list(DETERMINISM_CLASSES),
        "collect_implementation": "disabled_offline_source",
    }
    done["done_sha256"] = canonical_sha256(done)
    _validate_schema("done", done, repo_root)
    return done


def verify_analysis_bundle(
    *,
    schedule: Mapping[str, Any],
    journal: Mapping[str, Any],
    analysis: Mapping[str, Any],
    schedule_path: Path,
    journal_path: Path,
    analysis_path: Path,
    done: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    done_path: Path | None,
    schedule_payload: bytes | None = None,
    journal_payload: bytes | None = None,
    analysis_payload: bytes | None = None,
    repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT,
) -> None:
    _validate_schema("analysis", analysis, repo_root)
    _validate_seal(analysis, "analysis_sha256", role="analysis")
    regenerated = analyze(
        schedule,
        journal,
        journal_path=journal_path,
        generated_at_utc=analysis["generated_at_utc"],
        bootstrap_replicates=analysis["analysis_policy"]["bootstrap_replicates"],
        bootstrap_seed=analysis["analysis_policy"]["bootstrap_seed"],
        repo_root=repo_root,
    )
    if regenerated != analysis:
        _fail("M6_ANALYSIS_REDERIVATION", "determinism study differs")
    if done is None:
        return
    if done_path is None:
        _fail("M6_DONE_PATH", "missing")
    _validate_schema("done", done, repo_root)
    _validate_seal(done, "done_sha256", role="done")
    expected_done = build_done(
        schedule,
        journal,
        analysis,
        schedule_path=schedule_path,
        journal_path=journal_path,
        analysis_path=analysis_path,
        schedule_payload=schedule_payload,
        journal_payload=journal_payload,
        analysis_payload=analysis_payload,
        generated_at_utc=done["generated_at_utc"],
        repo_root=repo_root,
    )
    if expected_done != done:
        _fail("M6_DONE_REDERIVATION", "completion seal differs")


def _publish_analysis_directory(
    output: Path,
    *,
    analysis_payload: bytes,
    done_payload: bytes | None,
    repo_root: Path,
) -> Path:
    repository = _canonical_repo_root(repo_root)
    output = _lexical_absolute(output, role="M6 analysis output")
    parent = _resolve_no_symlink_chain(output.parent, role="M6 analysis parent")
    if not parent.is_dir():
        _fail("M6_OUTPUT_PARENT", str(parent))
    final = parent / output.name
    if _contains_path(repository, final) or _contains_path(final, repository):
        _fail(
            "M6_ANALYSIS_OUTPUT_OVERLAP",
            f"output={final} repository={repository}",
        )
    try:
        immutable.safe_relative_path(output.name)
    except immutable.ImmutableArtifactError as exc:
        _fail("M6_OUTPUT_PATH", f"{output}: {exc}")
    if output.name.startswith(".") or output.name.endswith(".staging"):
        _fail("M6_OUTPUT_PATH", f"reserved publication name: {output.name}")
    stage_name = f".{output.name}.staging"
    try:
        pinned_parent = immutable.PinnedDirectoryReader(parent)
    except (OSError, immutable.ImmutableArtifactError) as exc:
        _fail("M6_OUTPUT_PARENT", f"{parent}: {exc}")
    try:
        if _entry_metadata(pinned_parent.descriptor, output.name) is not None:
            _fail("M6_NO_OVERWRITE", str(output))
        if _entry_metadata(pinned_parent.descriptor, stage_name) is not None:
            _fail("M6_PARTIAL_PRESERVED", str(parent / stage_name))
        pinned_parent.verify_path()
    finally:
        pinned_parent.close()
    material = [
        immutable.ImmutableFile.from_bytes(
            "determinism_study.json", analysis_payload,
        )
    ]
    if done_payload is not None:
        material.append(
            immutable.ImmutableFile.from_bytes("M6_DONE.json", done_payload)
        )
    authorize_calls = 0

    def authorize(_root: Path, root_descriptor: int) -> None:
        nonlocal authorize_calls
        authorize_calls += 1
        if _entry_metadata(root_descriptor, output.name) is not None:
            _fail("M6_NO_OVERWRITE", str(output))
        if (
            authorize_calls == 1
            and _entry_metadata(root_descriptor, stage_name) is not None
        ):
            _fail("M6_PARTIAL_PRESERVED", str(parent / stage_name))

    try:
        published = immutable.publish_directory(
            parent,
            output.name,
            material,
            before_commit=authorize,
        )
        immutable.verify_published_files(published, material)
    except M6Error:
        raise
    except (OSError, immutable.ImmutableArtifactError) as exc:
        _fail("M6_ANALYSIS_PUBLICATION", f"{output}: {exc}")
    return published


def _load_mapping(path: Path, role: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bytes]:
    value, payload = load_json(path, role=role)
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        _fail("M6_ARTIFACT_SHAPE", f"{role}: object required")
    return value, payload


def _cmd_bind_m4(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    repository = _canonical_repo_root(Path(args.repo_root))
    archive_root = Path(args.m4_root)
    output = Path(args.out)
    _authorize_m4_receipt_output(
        output, archive_root=archive_root, repo_root=repository,
    )
    receipt = build_m4_binding_receipt(
        archive_root=archive_root,
        generated_at_utc=args.generated_at_utc,
        repo_root=repository,
    )
    _write_new(output, receipt)
    print(
        f"m4_identity_sha256={receipt['identity_sha256']} "
        f"chunks={len(receipt['chunk_done_manifests'])} "
        f"cells={len(receipt['cell_launch_identities'])}"
    )
    return 0


def _cmd_plan(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    schedule = build_schedule(
        matrix_path=Path(args.matrix),
        registry_path=Path(args.metric_registry),
        sidecar_schema_path=Path(args.sidecar_schema),
        m4_receipt_path=Path(args.m4_receipt) if args.m4_receipt else None,
        seed=args.seed,
        max_new_profiles_per_resume=args.max_new_profiles_per_resume,
        generated_at_utc=args.generated_at_utc,
        repo_root=Path(args.repo_root),
    )
    _write_new(Path(args.out), schedule)
    print(f"schedule_sha256={schedule['schedule_sha256']} tier1_slots=8540 maximum_slots=9760")
    return 0


def _cmd_publish_journal(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    repository = _canonical_repo_root(Path(args.repo_root))
    schedule, _ = _load_mapping(Path(args.schedule), "schedule")
    journal, _ = _load_mapping(Path(args.journal_draft), "journal draft")
    publish_journal(
        schedule,
        journal,
        output=Path(args.out),
        repo_root=repository,
    )
    print(f"journal_sha256={journal['journal_sha256']}")
    return 0


def _cmd_analyze(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    repo_root = _canonical_repo_root(Path(args.repo_root))
    schedule_path = Path(args.schedule)
    journal_path = Path(args.journal)
    schedule, schedule_payload = _load_mapping(schedule_path, "schedule")
    journal, journal_payload = _load_mapping(journal_path, "journal")
    analysis = analyze(
        schedule,
        journal,
        journal_path=journal_path,
        generated_at_utc=args.generated_at_utc,
        bootstrap_replicates=args.bootstrap_replicates,
        bootstrap_seed=args.bootstrap_seed,
        repo_root=repo_root,
    )
    analysis_payload = _pretty_json_bytes(analysis)
    emitted_done = (
        analysis["completion_state"] == "complete"
        and schedule["m4_identity"]["status"] == "complete"
    )
    if args.require_done and not emitted_done:
        _fail(
            "M6_DONE_NOT_EMITTED",
            f"completion={analysis['completion_state']} m4={schedule['m4_identity']['status']}",
        )
    out_dir = Path(args.out_dir)
    done_payload: bytes | None = None
    if emitted_done:
        done = build_done(
            schedule,
            journal,
            analysis,
            schedule_path=schedule_path,
            journal_path=journal_path,
            analysis_path=out_dir / "determinism_study.json",
            schedule_payload=schedule_payload,
            journal_payload=journal_payload,
            analysis_payload=analysis_payload,
            generated_at_utc=args.generated_at_utc,
            repo_root=repo_root,
        )
        done_payload = _pretty_json_bytes(done)
    _publish_analysis_directory(
        out_dir,
        analysis_payload=analysis_payload,
        done_payload=done_payload,
        repo_root=repo_root,
    )
    print(
        f"analysis_sha256={analysis['analysis_sha256']} "
        f"completion={analysis['completion_state']} "
        f"done={str(emitted_done).lower()}"
    )
    return 0


def _cmd_verify(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    repo_root = _canonical_repo_root(Path(args.repo_root))
    schedule_path = Path(args.schedule)
    schedule, schedule_payload = _load_mapping(schedule_path, "schedule")
    validate_schedule(schedule, repo_root=repo_root, rehash_sources=True)
    if not args.journal:
        print(f"verified_schedule_sha256={schedule['schedule_sha256']}")
        return 0
    journal_path = Path(args.journal)
    journal, journal_payload = _load_mapping(journal_path, "journal")
    validate_journal(
        schedule,
        journal,
        journal_path=journal_path,
        repo_root=repo_root,
        rehash_sidecars=True,
    )
    if not args.analysis_root:
        print(f"verified_journal_sha256={journal['journal_sha256']}")
        return 0
    root = _lexical_absolute(
        Path(args.analysis_root), role="M6 analysis root",
    )
    with _PinnedTreeTransaction(root, role="M6 analysis bundle") as transaction:
        observed = {
            path: kind
            for path, (kind, _snapshot) in transaction.inventory.items()
            if path
        }
        has_done = "M6_DONE.json" in observed
        expected = {"determinism_study.json"} | (
            {"M6_DONE.json"} if has_done else set()
        )
        if observed != {path: "file" for path in expected}:
            _fail(
                "M6_ANALYSIS_INVENTORY",
                f"observed={sorted(observed.items())}",
            )
        if args.require_done and not has_done:
            _fail("M6_DONE_MISSING", str(root / "M6_DONE.json"))
        analysis_payload = transaction.read(
            "determinism_study.json", role="analysis",
        )
        analysis = loads_strict(analysis_payload, role="analysis")
        if not isinstance(analysis, dict):
            _fail("M6_ARTIFACT_SHAPE", "analysis: object required")
        done: dict[str, Any] | None = None
        done_payload: bytes | None = None
        if has_done:
            done_payload = transaction.read("M6_DONE.json", role="done")
            loaded_done = loads_strict(done_payload, role="done")
            if not isinstance(loaded_done, dict):
                _fail("M6_ARTIFACT_SHAPE", "done: object required")
            done = loaded_done
        transaction.verify()
    analysis_path = root / "determinism_study.json"
    done_path = root / "M6_DONE.json"
    verify_analysis_bundle(
        schedule=schedule,
        journal=journal,
        analysis=analysis,
        schedule_path=schedule_path,
        journal_path=journal_path,
        analysis_path=analysis_path,
        done=done,
        done_path=done_path if done is not None else None,
        schedule_payload=schedule_payload,
        journal_payload=journal_payload,
        analysis_payload=analysis_payload,
        repo_root=repo_root,
    )
    material = [
        immutable.ImmutableFile.from_bytes(
            "determinism_study.json", analysis_payload,
        )
    ]
    if done_payload is not None:
        material.append(
            immutable.ImmutableFile.from_bytes("M6_DONE.json", done_payload)
        )
    try:
        immutable.verify_published_files(root, material)
    except (OSError, immutable.ImmutableArtifactError) as exc:
        _fail("M6_ANALYSIS_IMMUTABILITY", f"{root}: {exc}")
    print(
        f"verified_analysis_sha256={analysis['analysis_sha256']} "
        f"done={str(done is not None).lower()}"
    )
    return 0


def _cmd_collect(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    repo_root = Path(args.repo_root)
    schedule, _ = _load_mapping(Path(args.schedule), "schedule")
    validate_schedule(schedule, repo_root=repo_root, rehash_sources=True)
    matrix_payload = _resolve_repo_file(
        schedule["source_identity"]["canonical_matrix"],
        repo_root,
        role="canonical matrix",
    )
    matrix = loads_strict(matrix_payload, role="canonical matrix")
    _validate_m4_identity(
        schedule["m4_identity"],
        matrix=matrix,
        matrix_sha256=sha256_bytes(matrix_payload),
        cells=schedule["cells"],
        repo_root=repo_root,
        require_complete=True,
    )
    _fail(
        "M6_COLLECT_DISABLED_OFFLINE_SOURCE",
        "collection is intentionally absent; use the separately reviewed hardware owner after complete M4 identity",
    )


def _parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repo-root", default=str(REPO_ROOT))
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    bind_m4 = sub.add_parser(
        "bind-m4",
        help="derive one verified receipt from the exact 18 canonical M4 DONEs",
    )
    bind_m4.add_argument("--m4-root", required=True)
    bind_m4.add_argument("--generated-at-utc")
    bind_m4.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    bind_m4.set_defaults(func=_cmd_bind_m4)

    plan = sub.add_parser("plan", help="emit a sealed offline schedule")
    plan.add_argument("--matrix", default=str(MATRIX_PATH))
    plan.add_argument("--metric-registry", default=str(REGISTRY_PATH))
    plan.add_argument("--sidecar-schema", default=str(SIDECAR_SCHEMA_PATH))
    plan.add_argument("--m4-receipt")
    plan.add_argument("--seed", required=True, type=int)
    plan.add_argument("--max-new-profiles-per-resume", type=int, default=TIER1_SLOTS)
    plan.add_argument("--generated-at-utc")
    plan.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    plan.set_defaults(func=_cmd_plan)

    publish_journal_cmd = sub.add_parser(
        "publish-journal",
        help="validate a complete draft and publish one immutable raw journal",
    )
    publish_journal_cmd.add_argument("--schedule", required=True)
    publish_journal_cmd.add_argument("--journal-draft", required=True)
    publish_journal_cmd.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    publish_journal_cmd.set_defaults(func=_cmd_publish_journal)

    analyze_cmd = sub.add_parser("analyze", help="analyze immutable external v5 sidecars through a sealed journal")
    analyze_cmd.add_argument("--schedule", required=True)
    analyze_cmd.add_argument("--journal", required=True)
    analyze_cmd.add_argument("--out-dir", required=True)
    analyze_cmd.add_argument("--bootstrap-replicates", type=int, default=1000)
    analyze_cmd.add_argument("--bootstrap-seed", type=int)
    analyze_cmd.add_argument("--generated-at-utc")
    analyze_cmd.add_argument("--require-done", action="store_true")
    analyze_cmd.set_defaults(func=_cmd_analyze)

    verify = sub.add_parser("verify", help="rehash and semantically rederive offline artifacts")
    verify.add_argument("--schedule", required=True)
    verify.add_argument("--journal")
    verify.add_argument("--analysis-root")
    verify.add_argument("--require-done", action="store_true")
    verify.set_defaults(func=_cmd_verify)

    collect = sub.add_parser("collect", help="disabled in this offline source")
    collect.add_argument("--schedule", required=True)
    collect.set_defaults(func=_cmd_collect)
    return parser


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = _parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        return int(args.func(args))
    except M6Error as exc:
        print(f"ERROR {exc.code}: {exc.detail}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def _make_tree_readonly(root: Path) -> None:
    paths = list(root.rglob("*"))
    for path in paths:
        if path.is_file():
            path.chmod(0o444)
    for path in sorted(
        (path for path in paths if path.is_dir()),
        key=lambda item: len(item.parts),
        reverse=True,
    ):
        path.chmod(0o555)
    root.chmod(0o555)


def _sidecar_for_slot(schedule: dict, slot: dict, *, value: object = 0.5) -> dict:
    cell = next(item for item in schedule["cells"] if item["cell_id"] == slot["cell_id"])

def test_all_five_schemas_are_valid_and_closed_at_object_definitions() -> None:

        Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema)
        assert schema["additionalProperties"] is False
        for definition in schema.get("$defs", {}).values():
            if definition.get("type") == "object":
                assert definition.get("additionalProperties") is False

def test_strict_json_rejects_unsafe_numbers_depth_and_surrogates() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as unsafe_integer:
        campaign.loads_strict(b'{"value":9007199254740992}', role="unsafe")
    assert unsafe_integer.value.code == "M6_JSON_UNSAFE_INTEGER"
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as unsafe_float:
        campaign.loads_strict(b'{"value":1e20}', role="unsafe")
    assert unsafe_float.value.code == "M6_JSON_UNSAFE_FLOAT"
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as surrogate:
        campaign.loads_strict(b'{"value":"\\ud800"}', role="unsafe")
    assert surrogate.value.code == "M6_JSON_SURROGATE"
    nested = b"[" * 300 + b"0" + b"]" * 300
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as depth:
        campaign.loads_strict(nested, role="deep")
    assert depth.value.code in {"M6_JSON_DEPTH", "M6_JSON_PARSE"}

def test_completion_and_typed_exclusions_are_nonvacuous(schedule: dict) -> None:
    base = {
        "tier1_pending": 0,
        "trigger_state": "decided",
        "triggered_cells": 0,
        "tier2_pending": 0,
    }
    assert campaign._completion_state(
        **base,
        observed_slots=0,
        excluded_typed_slots=8_540,
        missing_selected_rows=469_700,
    ) == "incomplete_evidence"
    assert campaign._completion_state(
        **base,
        observed_slots=8_540,
        excluded_typed_slots=0,
        missing_selected_rows=1,
    ) == "incomplete_evidence"
    assert campaign._completion_state(
        **base,
        observed_slots=8_540,
        excluded_typed_slots=0,
        missing_selected_rows=0,
    ) == "complete"

    slot = schedule["slots"][0]
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as stop_cost:
        campaign.build_excluded_event(
            slot,
            reason="operator_stop",
            detail="operator requested pause",
            fresh_processes=1,
        )
    assert stop_cost.value.code == "M6_TYPED_EXCLUSION_CONTRACT"
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as missing_cost:
        campaign.build_excluded_event(
            slot,
            reason="sidecar_missing",
            detail="capture returned no sidecar",
        )
    assert missing_cost.value.code == "M6_TYPED_EXCLUSION_CONTRACT"

    invalid = campaign.build_excluded_event(
        slot,
        reason="profile_failed",
        detail="profiler exited nonzero",
        fresh_processes=1,
    )
    invalid["cost"]["fresh_processes"] = 0
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as resealed_invalid:
        campaign.build_journal(schedule, [invalid], created_at_utc=FIXED_TIME)
    assert resealed_invalid.value.code == "M6_TYPED_EXCLUSION_CONTRACT"

def test_dispersion_lockstep_scale_invariance_and_exact_d2() -> None:
    values = [10.0, 11.0, 9.0, 10.5, 9.5]
    assert dispersion_gate("stddev_abs", values) == pytest.approx(0.7905694150420949)
    assert dispersion_gate("coefficient_of_variation", values) == pytest.approx(
        dispersion_gate("coefficient_of_variation", [value * 100 for value in values])
    )
    assert sigma_rel("stddev_abs", values) == pytest.approx(
        sigma_rel("stddev_abs", [value * 100 for value in values])
    )
    assert sigma_rel("relative_tolerance", values) == pytest.approx(
        sigma_rel("relative_tolerance", [value * 100 for value in values])
    )
    assert [d2_for_n(n) for n in (5, 10, 20, 30)] == [2.326, 3.078, 3.735, 4.086]
    assert sigma_upper_factor(10) == pytest.approx(1.65, rel=0.04)
    assert sigma_upper_factor(20) == pytest.approx(1.37, rel=0.04)
    assert sigma_upper_factor(30) == pytest.approx(1.28, rel=0.04)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error):
        campaign._number(True, role="test")


def test_single_support_split_never_certifies_multimodal() -> None:
    result = modality_result(
        [0.877, 0.869, 0.851, 0.987, 0.878],
        discrete=False,
        absolute_resolution=0.0001,
        tier2=False,
    )
    assert result.outlier_flag is True
    assert result.certified is False


def test_continuous_multimodality_only_certifies_at_tier2() -> None:
    values = [1.0 + index * 0.0001 for index in range(15)] + [
        2.0 + index * 0.0001 for index in range(15)
    ]
    tier1 = modality_result(
        values[:20], discrete=False, absolute_resolution=0.0001, tier2=False
    )
    tier2 = modality_result(
        values, discrete=False, absolute_resolution=0.0001, tier2=True
    )
    assert tier1.certified is False
    assert tier2.flagged is True
    assert tier2.certified is True
    assert tier2.reason == "continuous_largest_gap_delta_bic"


def test_plan_cli_refuses_overwrite(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    out = tmp_path / "schedule.json"
    assert campaign.main([
        "plan", "--seed", "7", "--generated-at-utc", FIXED_TIME, "--out", str(out)
    ]) == 0
    before = out.read_bytes()
    assert out.stat().st_mode & 0o222 == 0
    assert not (tmp_path / ".schedule.json.m6-partial").exists()
    assert campaign.main([
        "plan", "--seed", "8", "--generated-at-utc", FIXED_TIME, "--out", str(out)
    ]) == 2
    assert out.read_bytes() == before


def test_anchored_input_snapshot_rejects_ancestor_symlink_and_same_size_mutation(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    real = tmp_path / "real"
    nested = real / "nested"
    nested.mkdir(parents=True)
    document = nested / "document.json"
    document.write_text('{"value":1}\n', encoding="utf-8")
    alias = tmp_path / "alias"
    alias.symlink_to(real, target_is_directory=True)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as ancestor_error:
        campaign.load_json(alias / "nested" / "document.json", role="ancestor test")
    assert ancestor_error.value.code == "M6_INPUT_SNAPSHOT"

    hardlink_source = tmp_path / "hardlink-source.bin"
    hardlink_alias = tmp_path / "hardlink-alias.bin"
    hardlink_source.write_bytes(b"possibly unique")
    hardlink_alias.hardlink_to(hardlink_source)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as hardlink_error:
        campaign._read_regular(hardlink_source, role="hardlink test")
    assert hardlink_error.value.code == "M6_INPUT_SNAPSHOT"

    large = tmp_path / "large.bin"
    large.write_bytes(b"a" * ((1 << 20) + 1))
    original_read = campaign.immutable.os.read
    mutated = False

    def mutate_after_first_block(descriptor: int, size: int) -> bytes:
        nonlocal mutated
        block = original_read(descriptor, size)
        if block and not mutated:
            mutated = True
            with large.open("r+b") as stream:
                stream.seek(-1, 2)
                stream.write(b"b")
                stream.flush()
                campaign.os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        return block

    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign.immutable.os, "read", mutate_after_first_block)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as mutation_error:
        campaign._read_regular(large, role="same-size mutation")
    assert mutation_error.value.code == "M6_INPUT_SNAPSHOT"


def test_single_file_publication_handles_zero_write_and_preserves_replacement(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    original_write = campaign.os.write
    zero_out = tmp_path / "zero.json"
    zero_partial = tmp_path / ".zero.json.m6-partial"
    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign.os, "write", lambda _fd, _view: 0)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as zero_error:
        campaign._write_new(zero_out, {"value": 1})
    assert zero_error.value.code == "M6_OUTPUT_WRITE"
    assert not zero_out.exists()
    assert not zero_partial.exists()

    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign.os, "write", original_write)
    race_out = tmp_path / "race.json"
    race_partial = tmp_path / ".race.json.m6-partial"
    replaced = False

    def replace_partial_then_fail(descriptor: int, view: memoryview) -> int:
        nonlocal replaced
        if not replaced:
            replaced = True
            race_partial.unlink()
            race_partial.write_bytes(b"foreign evidence")
        return 0

    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign.os, "write", replace_partial_then_fail)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as replacement_error:
        campaign._write_new(race_out, {"value": 1})
    assert replacement_error.value.code == "M6_OUTPUT_WRITE"
    assert not race_out.exists()
    assert race_partial.read_bytes() == b"foreign evidence"


def test_single_file_publication_rejects_symlinked_ancestor(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    real = tmp_path / "real"
    nested = real / "nested"
    nested.mkdir(parents=True)
    alias = tmp_path / "alias"
    alias.symlink_to(real, target_is_directory=True)
    output = alias / "nested" / "schedule.json"
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as error:
        campaign._write_new(output, {"value": 1})
    assert error.value.code == "M6_OUTPUT_PARENT"
    assert not (nested / "schedule.json").exists()


def test_event_transaction_rejects_generation_mixing(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    slot = next(
        item for item in schedule["slots"]
        if item["config_id"] == campaign.REFERENCE_CONFIG
    )
    sidecar_path = tmp_path / "label.json"
    sentinel = tmp_path / "unreferenced-evidence.bin"
    _write_json(sidecar_path, _sidecar_for_slot(schedule, slot))
    sentinel.write_bytes(b"before")
    original = campaign._sidecar_ref_and_observations
    mutated = False

    def mutate_unreferenced_generation(*args, **kwargs):  # noqa: ANN002,ANN003
        nonlocal mutated
        result = original(*args, **kwargs)
        if not mutated:
            mutated = True
            sentinel.write_bytes(b"after!")
        return result

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        campaign,
        "_sidecar_ref_and_observations",
        mutate_unreferenced_generation,
    )
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as error:
        campaign.build_observed_event(
            schedule,
            slot,
            [sidecar_path],
            journal_dir=tmp_path,
            observed_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
            ncu_replay_pass_count=1,
        )
    assert error.value.code == "M6_TREE_CHANGED"


def _artifact(path: Path, root: Path, kind: str) -> dict:
    payload = path.read_bytes()
    return {
        "artifact_kind": kind,
        "relative_path": path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
        "sha256": campaign.sha256_bytes(payload),
        "size_bytes": len(payload),
    }


def _m4_sidecar(matrix: dict, matrix_cell: dict, schedule_cell: dict) -> dict:
    registry = json.loads(campaign._git_blob_bytes(
        campaign.REPO_ROOT,
        matrix["source_commit"],
        campaign.REGISTRY_PATH.relative_to(campaign.REPO_ROOT).as_posix(),
        role="fixture source registry",
    ))
    units = {row["ncu_metric"]: row["unit"] for row in registry["metrics"]}
    invocation = matrix_cell["invocation"]
    launch_index = invocation["capture_launch_contract"]["label_launch_index"]
    profile_from_start = invocation["shape_delivery"] == "application_args"
    return {
        "schema_version": 5,
        "device": "sm_86",
        "slug": schedule_cell["slug"],
        "shape_point": schedule_cell["shape_point"],
        "repeat_index": 0,
        "launch_index": launch_index,
        "binary_sha256": schedule_cell["binary_sha256"],
        "profiler_family": "nsight_compute",
        "profiler_version": "2026.1.0",
        "cuda_version": "13.2",
        "driver_version": "610.43.02",
        "gpu_uuid_sha256": "1" * 64,
        "replay_mode": "kernel",
        "aggregation": "kernel",
        "warmup_count": invocation["capture_launch_contract"][
            "label_driver_warmup_count"
        ],
        "cache_hit_rate_l2_sector": 0.5,
        "confidence_interval_l2_sector": {
            "lower": 0.5,
            "upper": 0.5,
            "confidence_level": 0.95,
            "units": "sector_hit_rate_fraction",
            "aggregation": "kernel",
        },
        "cache_hit_rate_l1tex_sector": 0.5,
        "confidence_interval_l1tex_sector": {
            "lower": 0.5,
            "upper": 0.5,
            "confidence_level": 0.95,
            "units": "sector_hit_rate_fraction",
            "aggregation": "kernel",
        },
        "unit_tagged_metrics": [
            {
                "ncu_metric": metric,
                "unit": units[metric],
                "value": 0.5 if units[metric] == "pct" else 1.0,
            }
            for metric in matrix["metric_registry"]["collection"][
                "selected_unit_metrics"
            ]
        ],
        "measurement_protocol": {
            "ncu_clock_control": "none",
            "ncu_cache_control": "all",
            "ncu_replay_mode": "kernel",
            "ncu_target_processes": "all",
            "ncu_filter_mode": "global",
            "ncu_profile_from_start": profile_from_start,
            "ncu_launch_skip": launch_index,
            "ncu_launch_count": 1,
            "host_persistence_mode": "Enabled",
            "host_sm_clock_mhz": 1350,
            "host_mem_clock_mhz": 10501,
            "host_temperature_c": 61,
        },
    }


def _fake_m4_archive(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> tuple[dict, Path]:
    matrix = json.loads(campaign.MATRIX_PATH.read_text())
    original_git_blob = campaign._git_blob_bytes

    def fixture_git_blob(repo_root, source_commit, relative_path, *, role):
        if relative_path == campaign.SIDECAR_SCHEMA_PATH.relative_to(
            campaign.REPO_ROOT
        ).as_posix():
            return campaign.SIDECAR_SCHEMA_PATH.read_bytes()
        return original_git_blob(
            repo_root, source_commit, relative_path, role=role,
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign, "_git_blob_bytes", fixture_git_blob)
    matrix_cells = {
        (
            cell["identity"]["roster_source"],
            cell["identity"]["slug"],
        ): cell
        for cell in matrix["cells"]
    }
    schedule_cells = {cell["cell_id"]: cell for cell in schedule["cells"]}
    root = tmp_path / "m4"
    (root / "chunks").mkdir(parents=True)
    for chunk in matrix["chunks"]:
        chunk_root = root / "chunks" / chunk["chunk_id"]
        chunk_root.mkdir()
        rows = []
        for member in chunk["cells"]:
            source = member["roster_source"]
            slug = member["slug"]
            cell_id = f"{source}:{slug}"
            matrix_cell = matrix_cells[(source, slug)]
            schedule_cell = schedule_cells[cell_id]
            cell_root = chunk_root / "cells" / f"{source}__{slug}"
            cell_root.mkdir(parents=True)
            sidecar_path = cell_root / "label.json"
            run_path = cell_root / "run.json"
            report_path = cell_root / "report.ncu-rep"
            observation_path = cell_root / "launch.json"
            capture_path = cell_root / "capture.json"
            sidecar = _m4_sidecar(matrix, matrix_cell, schedule_cell)
            launch_index = sidecar["launch_index"]
            controls, _profile_from_start, shape_binding = (
                campaign._m4_expected_controls(matrix_cell, launch_index)
            )
            _write_json(sidecar_path, sidecar)
            signature = campaign.sha256_bytes(
                f"{slug}|{matrix_cell['invocation']['executable_path']}".encode()
            )
            run = {
                "schema_version": 1,
                "source_commit": matrix["source_commit"],

            }
            _write_json(run_path, run)
            report_path.write_bytes(f"report:{cell_id}".encode())
            identity_columns = [
                "ID", "Device", "Kernel Name", "Block Size", "Grid Size",
            ]
            observation = {
                "schema_version": 1,
                "kind": "ncu_details_csv_launch_observation",
                "kernel_name_base": "mangled",

            observation["observation_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
                observation

            _write_json(observation_path, observation)
            artifact_records = {

                    run_path, chunk_root, "label_run_manifest"

            )

                        ]["sha256"],

                            "observation_sha256"

        done = {

            "manifest_kind": "campaign_chunk_done",
            "chunk_id": chunk["chunk_id"],
            "output_root": str(chunk_root),
            "source_commit_pre": matrix["source_commit"],
            "source_commit_post": matrix["source_commit"],
            "source_head_at_seal": matrix["source_commit"],
            "source_commit_stable": True,
            "working_tree_clean": True,
            "protocol_version": "2.1",
            "arch": "sm_86",
            "capture_matrix_sha256": campaign.sha256_bytes(
                campaign.MATRIX_PATH.read_bytes()
            ),
            "matrix_seal_sha256": matrix["matrix_seal_sha256"],
            "roster_authority_sha256": matrix["authority"]["sha256"],
            "chunk_membership_sha256": chunk["membership_sha256"],
            "expected_cells": len(rows),
            "preflight_sha256": "e" * 64,
            "cell_results": rows,
        }
        _write_json(chunk_root / "DONE.json", done)
    _make_tree_readonly(root)

    def verified_done(*args, **kwargs):  # noqa: ANN002,ANN003
        assert len(args) == 1
        assert kwargs == {
            "repo_root": campaign.REPO_ROOT,
            "rehash_references": True,
            "require_current_head": True,
            "require_clean_tree": True,
        }
        return []

    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign.m4_done, "verify_seal", verified_done)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        campaign.matrix_builder, "validate_matrix", lambda *args, **kwargs: []
    )
    return matrix, root


def _schedule_with_complete_m4(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> tuple[dict, Path, dict]:
    matrix, root = _fake_m4_archive(schedule, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    receipt = campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
        archive_root=root,
        generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
    )
    complete = copy.deepcopy(schedule)
    complete["m4_identity"] = receipt
    complete["schedule_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
        campaign._without(complete, "schedule_sha256")
    )
    campaign.validate_schedule(complete)
    return matrix, root, complete


def _repeat_evidence_bundle(
    schedule: dict,
    slot: dict,
    journal_dir: Path,
    *,
    kernel_name: str | None = None,
    kernel_signature_sha256: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[Path, dict[str, Path], dict]:
    journal_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    cell = next(item for item in schedule["cells"] if item["cell_id"] == slot["cell_id"])
    config = next(
        item for item in schedule["configs"] if item["config_id"] == slot["config_id"]
    )
    m4_cell = next(
        item
        for item in schedule["m4_identity"]["cell_launch_identities"]
        if item["cell_id"] == slot["cell_id"]
    )
    assert len(m4_cell["launches"]) == 1
    m4_launch = m4_cell["launches"][0]
    launch_index = m4_launch["launch_index"]
    observed_kernel = kernel_name or m4_launch["kernel_name"]
    observed_signature = (
        kernel_signature_sha256 or m4_launch["kernel_signature_sha256"]
    )
    signature_source = m4_launch["kernel_signature_source"]

    sidecar_path = journal_dir / "repeat_label.json"
    run_path = journal_dir / "repeat_run.json"
    report_path = journal_dir / "repeat_report.ncu-rep"
    observation_path = journal_dir / "repeat_launch.json"
    capture_path = journal_dir / "repeat_capture.json"

    sidecar = _sidecar_for_slot(schedule, slot)
    sidecar["launch_index"] = launch_index
    sidecar["measurement_protocol"]["ncu_launch_skip"] = launch_index
    _write_json(sidecar_path, sidecar)
    controls = campaign._m6_repeat_controls(config, launch_index)
    run = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "source_commit": schedule["source_identity"]["matrix_source_commit"],
        "binary_sha256": cell["binary_sha256"],
        "kernel_signature_sha256": observed_signature,
        "kernel_signature_source": signature_source,
        "arch": "sm_86",
        "slug": cell["slug"],
        "shape_point": cell["shape_point"],
        "repeat_index": slot["repeat_index"],
        "launch_index": launch_index,
        "ncu_controls": controls,
    }
    _write_json(run_path, run)
    report_path.write_bytes(f"repeat-report:{slot['slot_id']}".encode())
    identity_columns = [
        "ID", "Device", "Kernel Name", "Block Size", "Grid Size",
    ]
    observation = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "kind": "ncu_details_csv_launch_observation",
        "kernel_name_base": "mangled",
        "requested_launch_skip": launch_index,
        "requested_launch_count": 1,
        "report_sha256": campaign.sha256_bytes(report_path.read_bytes()),
        "identity_columns": identity_columns,
        "identity": {
            "ID": str(launch_index),
            "Device": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 Ti (0)",
            "Kernel Name": observed_kernel,
            "Block Size": "(128, 1, 1)",
            "Grid Size": "(1, 1, 1)",
        },
    }
    observation["observation_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(observation)
    _write_json(observation_path, observation)

    def receipt(path: Path) -> dict:
        payload = path.read_bytes()
        return {
            "sha256": campaign.sha256_bytes(payload),
            "size_bytes": len(payload),
        }

    artifact_receipt = {
        "label_sidecar": receipt(sidecar_path),
        "label_run_manifest": receipt(run_path),
        "ncu_report": receipt(report_path),
        "ncu_launch_observation": {
            **receipt(observation_path),
            "observation_sha256": observation["observation_sha256"],
        },
    }
    capture = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "artifact_kind": "m6_repeat_capture_manifest",
        "source_commit": schedule["source_identity"]["matrix_source_commit"],
        "schedule_sha256": schedule["schedule_sha256"],
        "slot_id": slot["slot_id"],
        "slot_sha256": slot["slot_sha256"],
        "cell_id": cell["cell_id"],
        "cell_identity_sha256": cell["cell_identity_sha256"],
        "config_id": config["config_id"],
        "config_sha256": config["config_sha256"],
        "repeat_index": slot["repeat_index"],
        "launch_index": launch_index,
        "binary_sha256": cell["binary_sha256"],
        "kernel_name": observed_kernel,
        "kernel_signature_sha256": observed_signature,
        "kernel_signature_source": signature_source,
        "ncu_controls": controls,
        "validated_artifact_receipt": artifact_receipt,
    }
    capture["capture_manifest_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(capture)
    _write_json(capture_path, capture)
    return sidecar_path, {
        "label_run_manifest": run_path,
        "ncu_report": report_path,
        "ncu_launch_observation": observation_path,
        "label_capture_manifest": capture_path,
    }, m4_launch


def test_complete_m4_receipt_is_rederived_from_verified_done_artifacts(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    matrix, root = _fake_m4_archive(schedule, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    receipt = campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
        archive_root=root,
        generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
    )
    assert len(receipt["chunk_done_manifests"]) == 18
    assert len(receipt["cell_launch_identities"]) == 122
    assert receipt["preflight_sha256s"] == ["e" * 64]
    campaign._validate_m4_identity(
        receipt,
        matrix=matrix,
        matrix_sha256=campaign.sha256_bytes(campaign.MATRIX_PATH.read_bytes()),
        cells=schedule["cells"],
        repo_root=campaign.REPO_ROOT,
        require_complete=True,
    )

    fake = copy.deepcopy(receipt)
    fake_launch = fake["cell_launch_identities"][0]["launches"][0]
    fake_launch["kernel_name"] += "_fake"
    fake_launch["launch_identity_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
        campaign._without(fake_launch, "launch_identity_sha256")
    )
    fake["cell_launch_identities"][0]["launch_set_sha256"] = (
        campaign.canonical_sha256(
            fake["cell_launch_identities"][0]["launches"]
        )
    )
    fake["identity_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
        campaign._without(fake, "identity_sha256")
    )
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as error:
        campaign._validate_m4_identity(
            fake,
            matrix=matrix,
            matrix_sha256=campaign.sha256_bytes(
                campaign.MATRIX_PATH.read_bytes()
            ),
            cells=schedule["cells"],
            repo_root=campaign.REPO_ROOT,
            require_complete=True,
        )
    assert error.value.code == "M6_M4_RECEIPT_REDERIVATION"


def test_bind_m4_refuses_authoritative_done_verifier_failure(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    _matrix, root = _fake_m4_archive(schedule, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        campaign.m4_done,
        "verify_seal",
        lambda *args, **kwargs: ["forged DONE"],
    )
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as error:
        campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
            archive_root=root,
            generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        )
    assert error.value.code == "M6_M4_DONE_UNVERIFIED"


def test_m4_binding_rejects_cross_generation_tree(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    _matrix, root = _fake_m4_archive(schedule, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    sentinel = root / "unreferenced-evidence.bin"
    root.chmod(0o755)
    sentinel.write_bytes(b"before")
    sentinel.chmod(0o444)
    root.chmod(0o555)
    mutated = False

    def mutate_tree(*args, **kwargs):  # noqa: ANN002,ANN003
        nonlocal mutated
        if not mutated:
            mutated = True
            sentinel.chmod(0o644)
            sentinel.write_bytes(b"after!")
            sentinel.chmod(0o444)
        return []

    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign.m4_done, "verify_seal", mutate_tree)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as error:
        campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
            archive_root=root,
            generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        )
    assert error.value.code == "M6_TREE_CHANGED"


def test_bind_m4_refuses_cross_root_done_and_no_overwrite(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    matrix, root = _fake_m4_archive(schedule, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    chunk_id = matrix["chunks"][0]["chunk_id"]
    done_path = root / "chunks" / chunk_id / "DONE.json"
    done = json.loads(done_path.read_text())
    done["output_root"] = str(tmp_path / "different-root")
    done_path.chmod(0o644)
    _write_json(done_path, done)
    done_path.chmod(0o444)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as error:
        campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
            archive_root=root,
            generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        )
    assert error.value.code == "M6_M4_DONE_BINDING"

    _matrix, second_root = _fake_m4_archive(
        schedule, tmp_path / "second", monkeypatch,
    )
    out = tmp_path / "receipt.json"
    assert campaign.main([
        "bind-m4", "--m4-root", str(second_root),
        "--generated-at-utc", FIXED_TIME, "--out", str(out),
    ]) == 0
    before = out.read_bytes()
    assert campaign.main([
        "bind-m4", "--m4-root", str(second_root),
        "--generated-at-utc", FIXED_TIME, "--out", str(out),
    ]) == 2
    assert out.read_bytes() == before


def test_m4_binding_refuses_authority_overlap_partial_and_missing_capture(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    matrix, root = _fake_m4_archive(schedule, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    receipt = campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
        archive_root=root,
        generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
    )
    writable_done = root / "chunks" / matrix["chunks"][0]["chunk_id"] / "DONE.json"
    writable_done.chmod(0o644)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as writable_error:
        campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
            archive_root=root,
            generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        )
    assert writable_error.value.code == "M6_TREE_SNAPSHOT"
    writable_done.chmod(0o444)
    matrix_sha256 = campaign.sha256_bytes(campaign.MATRIX_PATH.read_bytes())

    incomplete = copy.deepcopy(schedule["m4_identity"])
    incomplete["completed_cells"] = 121
    incomplete["identity_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
        campaign._without(incomplete, "identity_sha256")
    )
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as incomplete_error:
        campaign._validate_m4_identity(
            incomplete,
            matrix=matrix,
            matrix_sha256=matrix_sha256,
            cells=schedule["cells"],
            repo_root=campaign.REPO_ROOT,
            require_complete=False,
        )
    assert incomplete_error.value.code == "M6_M4_INCOMPLETE_IDENTITY"

    partial = copy.deepcopy(receipt)
    partial["completed_cells"] = 121
    partial["cell_launch_identities"].pop()
    partial["identity_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
        campaign._without(partial, "identity_sha256")
    )
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as partial_error:
        campaign._validate_m4_identity(
            partial,
            matrix=matrix,
            matrix_sha256=matrix_sha256,
            cells=schedule["cells"],
            repo_root=campaign.REPO_ROOT,
            require_complete=True,
        )
    assert partial_error.value.code == "M6_SCHEMA_VALIDATION"

    for output in (
        root / "overlapping-receipt.json",
        campaign.REPO_ROOT / ".m6-overlapping-receipt-test.json",
    ):
        assert not output.exists()
        with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as overlap_error:
            campaign._authorize_m4_receipt_output(
                output,
                archive_root=root,
                repo_root=campaign.REPO_ROOT,
            )
        assert overlap_error.value.code == "M6_M4_RECEIPT_OUTPUT_OVERLAP"
        assert not output.exists()

    alternate_matrix = tmp_path / "alternate-matrix.json"
    alternate_matrix.write_bytes(campaign.MATRIX_PATH.read_bytes())
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as matrix_error:
        campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
            archive_root=root,
            matrix_path=alternate_matrix,
            generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        )
    assert matrix_error.value.code == "M6_SOURCE_AUTHORITY"

    alternate_repo = tmp_path / "alternate-repository"
    alternate_repo.mkdir()
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as repository_error:
        campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
            archive_root=root,
            repo_root=alternate_repo,
            generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        )
    assert repository_error.value.code == "M6_REPOSITORY_AUTHORITY"

    chunk_id = matrix["chunks"][0]["chunk_id"]
    done_path = root / "chunks" / chunk_id / "DONE.json"
    done = json.loads(done_path.read_text())
    done["cell_results"][0]["artifacts"] = [
        artifact
        for artifact in done["cell_results"][0]["artifacts"]
        if artifact["artifact_kind"] != "label_capture_manifest"
    ]
    done_path.chmod(0o644)
    _write_json(done_path, done)
    done_path.chmod(0o444)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as capture_error:
        campaign.build_m4_binding_receipt(
            archive_root=root,
            generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        )
    assert capture_error.value.code == "M6_M4_ARTIFACT_CARDINALITY"


def test_complete_m4_repeat_evidence_rejects_same_index_wrong_kernel(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    _matrix, _root, complete = _schedule_with_complete_m4(
        schedule, tmp_path / "archive", monkeypatch,
    )
    slot = complete["slots"][0]
    valid_dir = tmp_path / "valid-repeat"
    sidecar_path, evidence_paths, m4_launch = _repeat_evidence_bundle(
        complete, slot, valid_dir,
    )
    event = campaign.build_observed_event(
        complete,
        slot,
        [sidecar_path],
        journal_dir=valid_dir,
        observed_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        ncu_replay_pass_count=2,
        launch_evidence_paths=[evidence_paths],
    )
    assert event["sidecars"][0]["m4_launch_identity_sha256"] == (
        m4_launch["launch_identity_sha256"]
    )
    assert event["sidecars"][0]["launch_evidence"]["kernel_name"] == (
        m4_launch["kernel_name"]
    )
    journal = campaign.build_journal(
        complete, [event], created_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
    )
    journal_path = valid_dir / "journal.json"
    _write_json(journal_path, journal)
    campaign.validate_journal(complete, journal, journal_path=journal_path)

    missing_capture = dict(evidence_paths)
    missing_capture.pop("label_capture_manifest")
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as missing_error:
        campaign.build_observed_event(
            complete,
            slot,
            [sidecar_path],
            journal_dir=valid_dir,
            observed_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
            ncu_replay_pass_count=2,
            launch_evidence_paths=[missing_capture],
        )
    assert missing_error.value.code == "M6_REPEAT_EVIDENCE_PATHS"

    wrong_dir = tmp_path / "wrong-kernel-repeat"
    wrong_sidecar, wrong_evidence, _ = _repeat_evidence_bundle(
        complete,
        slot,
        wrong_dir,
        kernel_name=f"{m4_launch['kernel_name']}_different_kernel",
        kernel_signature_sha256="f" * 64,
    )
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as wrong_kernel_error:
        campaign.build_observed_event(
            complete,
            slot,
            [wrong_sidecar],
            journal_dir=wrong_dir,
            observed_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
            ncu_replay_pass_count=2,
            launch_evidence_paths=[wrong_evidence],
        )
    assert wrong_kernel_error.value.code == "M6_M4_KERNEL_IDENTITY"

    schedule_path = tmp_path / "schedule.json"
    _write_json(schedule_path, schedule)
    assert campaign.main(["collect", "--schedule", str(schedule_path)]) == 2
    assert "M6_M4_INCOMPLETE" in capsys.readouterr().err


def test_collect_is_unconditionally_disabled_after_prerequisite_gate(
    schedule: dict, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys
) -> None:
    schedule_path = tmp_path / "schedule.json"
    _write_json(schedule_path, schedule)
    original = campaign._validate_m4_identity

    def allow_complete(*args, **kwargs):  # noqa: ANN002,ANN003
        if kwargs.get("require_complete"):
            return None
        return original(*args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(campaign, "_validate_m4_identity", allow_complete)
    assert campaign.main(["collect", "--schedule", str(schedule_path)]) == 2
    assert "M6_COLLECT_DISABLED_OFFLINE_SOURCE" in capsys.readouterr().err


def test_external_v5_oor_value_is_retained_uncensored(schedule: dict, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    slot = next(slot for slot in schedule["slots"] if slot["config_id"] == campaign.REFERENCE_CONFIG)
    sidecar_path = tmp_path / "label.json"
    _write_json(sidecar_path, _sidecar_for_slot(schedule, slot, value=1.25))
    event = campaign.build_observed_event(
        schedule,
        slot,
        [sidecar_path],
        journal_dir=tmp_path,
        observed_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        ncu_replay_pass_count=3,
    )
    journal = campaign.build_journal(schedule, [event], created_at_utc=FIXED_TIME)
    journal_path = tmp_path / "journal.json"
    _write_json(journal_path, journal)
    analysis = campaign.analyze(
        schedule,
        journal,
        journal_path=journal_path,
        generated_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        bootstrap_replicates=10,
    )
    raw = next(
        row
        for row in analysis["row_accounting"]
        if row["metric_key"] == "cache_hit_rate_l2_sector"
        and row["value"] is not None
    )
    assert raw["value"] == 1.25
    assert raw["validity"] == "out_of_range_high"
    assert raw["typed_reason"] == "ncu_pct_overflow"
    classification = next(
        row
        for row in analysis["classifications"]
        if row["cell_id"] == slot["cell_id"]
        and row["config_id"] == campaign.REFERENCE_CONFIG
        and row["metric_key"] == "cache_hit_rate_l2_sector"
    )
    assert classification["determinism_class"] == "vendor_defect"
    assert analysis["analysis_policy"]["raw_values_clamped"] is False
    decision = next(
        row for row in analysis["trigger_decisions"] if row["cell_id"] == slot["cell_id"]
    )
    assert decision["triggered"] is True
    assert "out_of_range" in decision["reason_codes"]
    assert analysis["accounting"]["collected_identity_holds"] is True
    assert analysis["accounting"]["denominator_identity_holds"] is True


def test_parser_repair_diagnostic_is_replaced_by_uncensored_source_value(
    schedule: dict, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    slot = next(slot for slot in schedule["slots"] if slot["config_id"] == campaign.REFERENCE_CONFIG)
    sidecar = _sidecar_for_slot(schedule, slot, value=1.0)
    sidecar["parser_diagnostics"] = {
        "ncu_sector_hit_rate_clamped_to_100": [
            {
                "metric_label": "lts__t_sector_hit_rate.pct",
                "raw_value": 103.25,
            }
        ]
    }
    sidecar_path = tmp_path / "diagnostic.json"
    _write_json(sidecar_path, sidecar)
    event = campaign.build_observed_event(
        schedule,
        slot,
        [sidecar_path],
        journal_dir=tmp_path,
        observed_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        ncu_replay_pass_count=2,
    )
    observation = next(
        row
        for row in event["raw_observations"]
        if row["metric_key"] == "cache_hit_rate_l2_sector"
    )
    assert observation["value"] == pytest.approx(1.0325)
    assert observation["source_emitted_value"] == 103.25
    assert observation["source_emitted_unit"] == "percent"
    assert observation["source_pointer"].startswith("/parser_diagnostics/")

def test_journal_publication_is_exclusive_and_readonly(
    schedule: dict,
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    journal = campaign.build_journal(
        schedule,
        [
            campaign.build_excluded_event(
                schedule["slots"][0],
                reason="operator_stop",
                detail="fixture",
            )
        ],
        created_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
    )
    output = tmp_path / "journal.json"
    campaign.publish_journal(schedule, journal, output=output)

def test_journal_hash_chain_and_sidecar_immutability_are_verified(
    schedule: dict, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    slot = next(slot for slot in schedule["slots"] if slot["config_id"] == campaign.REFERENCE_CONFIG)
    sidecar_path = tmp_path / "label.json"
    _write_json(sidecar_path, _sidecar_for_slot(schedule, slot))
    event = campaign.build_observed_event(
        schedule,
        slot,
        [sidecar_path],
        journal_dir=tmp_path,
        observed_at_utc=FIXED_TIME,
        ncu_replay_pass_count=2,
    )
    journal = campaign.build_journal(schedule, [event], created_at_utc=FIXED_TIME)
    journal_path = tmp_path / "journal.json"
    _write_json(journal_path, journal)
    campaign.validate_journal(schedule, journal, journal_path=journal_path)

    tampered = copy.deepcopy(journal)
    tampered["events"][0]["raw_observations"][0]["value"] = 0.75
    tampered["events"][0]["event_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
        campaign._without(tampered["events"][0], "event_sha256")
    )
    tampered["journal_sha256"] = campaign.canonical_sha256(
        campaign._without(tampered, "journal_sha256")
    )
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as error:
        campaign.validate_journal(schedule, tampered, journal_path=journal_path)
    assert error.value.code == "M6_RAW_OBSERVATION_MISMATCH"

    sidecar = json.loads(sidecar_path.read_text())
    sidecar["cache_hit_rate_l2_sector"] = 0.6
    _write_json(sidecar_path, sidecar)
    with pytest.raises(campaign.M6Error) as changed:
        campaign.validate_journal(schedule, journal, journal_path=journal_path)
    assert changed.value.code == "M6_SIDECAR_REFERENCE"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Emit and verify immutable, resumable capture-chunk DONE manifests.

A DONE manifest is a cryptographic resume boundary, not a progress counter.  It
names the exact nonempty matrix chunk, accounts for every member with one typed
outcome, pins every admitted artifact and campaign input, and semantically
revalidates current-matrix SOL native-environment attestations.  Sealing is
refused unless the repository is clean and still at the preflight/source commit.

``verify_seal`` is deliberately a consumer-side verifier: by default it re-reads
and hashes every referenced input and artifact, re-derives membership/counts,
cross-checks the capture matrix and roster authority, and re-checks git HEAD and
cleanliness.  An empty problem list is therefore safe evidence that a chunk may
be skipped during resume.
"""

def _load_certified_sol_native_env_hash() -> str:
    """Derive the DONE verifier's hash from the tracked fingerprint authority.

    This module deliberately has no second literal copy of the environment
    identity.  A malformed, degraded, or internally stale fingerprint must make
    the verifier unavailable rather than silently certifying an obsolete host.
    """
    path = REPO_ROOT / SOL_NATIVE_ENV_PIN_PATH
    try:
        document = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"certified SOL native fingerprint is unreadable: {path}: {exc}"
        ) from exc
    components = document.get("components") if isinstance(document, dict) else None
    if (
        not isinstance(document, dict)
        or document.get("schema_version") != 1
        or document.get("fingerprint_id")
        != "sm86_sol_native_env_fingerprint_v1"
        or document.get("arch") != "sm_86"
        or document.get("sku") != "rtx_3090_ti"
        or document.get("degraded") is not False
        or document.get("missing_components") != []
        or not isinstance(components, dict)
        or set(components) != set(SOL_NATIVE_ENV_COMPONENTS)
        or not all(isinstance(value, str) for value in components.values())
    ):
        raise RuntimeError("certified SOL native fingerprint contract is invalid")
    derived = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(
        components, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("ascii")).hexdigest()
    if document.get("native_env_hash") != derived:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "certified SOL native fingerprint native_env_hash is stale"
        )
    return derived

    "35672d28ddfcec9c9e2a9eb1021d7fc7c84b458e1865406ff0b4aa349a45d003"
)

class DoneManifestError(Exception):
    """A typed seal refusal; callers must not write a DONE file."""


def _sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def _canonical_sha256(value: Any) -> str:
    payload = json.dumps(
        value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False,
    ).encode("utf-8")
    return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()


def _sol_stage_manifest_sha256(value: Any) -> str:
    """Reproduce the unchanged SOL adapter stage-definition hash domain."""
    payload = (
        json.dumps(
            value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False,
        )
        + "\n"
    ).encode("utf-8")
    return hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()


def _is_historical_bootstrap(manifest: Any) -> bool:
    """Return whether ``manifest`` is the one explicitly allowlisted seal."""
    return (
        isinstance(manifest, dict)
        and _canonical_sha256(manifest)
        == HISTORICAL_BOOTSTRAP_CANONICAL_SHA256
    )


def _parse_utc_timestamp(raw: Any, where: str, problems: list[str]) -> datetime | None:
    """Parse an aware UTC RFC-3339 timestamp without normalizing bad evidence."""
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw:
        problems.append(f"{where} is not a nonempty UTC timestamp: {raw!r}")
        return None
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(raw.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except ValueError:
        problems.append(f"{where} is not a valid UTC timestamp: {raw!r}")
        return None
    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() != timezone.utc.utcoffset(parsed):
        problems.append(f"{where} is not UTC: {raw!r}")
        return None
    return parsed


def _normalize_admission(
    admission: Any, *, problems: list[str], where: str = "admission",
) -> tuple[str | None, dict[str, datetime]]:
    """Validate the closed single-preflight invocation ledger in DONE."""
    if not isinstance(admission, dict):
        problems.append(f"{where} is not an object")
        return None, {}
    unknown = sorted(set(admission) - _ADMISSION_FIELDS)
    missing = sorted(_ADMISSION_FIELDS - set(admission))
    if unknown or missing:
        problems.append(
            f"{where} field set mismatch: missing={missing}, unknown={unknown}"
        )
    generated = admission.get("preflight_generated_at_utc")
    generated_at = _parse_utc_timestamp(
        generated, f"{where}.preflight_generated_at_utc", problems,
    )
    invocations = admission.get("capture_invocations")
    if not isinstance(invocations, list) or not invocations:
        problems.append(f"{where}.capture_invocations must be a nonempty array")
        return generated if isinstance(generated, str) else None, {}
    normalized: dict[str, datetime] = {}
    for index, row in enumerate(invocations):
        label = f"{where}.capture_invocations[{index}]"
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            problems.append(f"{label} is not an object")
            continue
        unknown = sorted(set(row) - _CAPTURE_INVOCATION_FIELDS)
        missing = sorted(_CAPTURE_INVOCATION_FIELDS - set(row))
        if unknown or missing:
            problems.append(
                f"{label} field set mismatch: missing={missing}, unknown={unknown}"
            )
        run_id = row.get("run_id")
        if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not run_id:
            problems.append(f"{label}.run_id is not a nonempty string")
            continue
        admitted = _parse_utc_timestamp(
            row.get("admitted_at_utc"), f"{label}.admitted_at_utc", problems,
        )
        if admitted is not None and generated_at is not None:
            from campaign_preflight import (  # noqa: E402
                PREFLIGHT_FRESHNESS_SECONDS,
                PREFLIGHT_FUTURE_SKEW_SECONDS,
            )
            age_seconds = (admitted - generated_at).total_seconds()
            if age_seconds > PREFLIGHT_FRESHNESS_SECONDS:
                problems.append(
                    f"{label} admission exceeds the inclusive "
                    f"{PREFLIGHT_FRESHNESS_SECONDS:.3f}s preflight window"
                )
            if age_seconds < -PREFLIGHT_FUTURE_SKEW_SECONDS:
                problems.append(
                    f"{label} preflight exceeds the "
                    f"{PREFLIGHT_FUTURE_SKEW_SECONDS:.3f}s future-skew bound"
                )
        if run_id in normalized:
            problems.append(f"{where} has duplicate run_id {run_id!r}")
        elif admitted is not None:
            normalized[run_id] = admitted
    return generated if isinstance(generated, str) else None, normalized


def authority_cell_sha256(cell: dict) -> str:
    """Return the canonical identity of one complete authority cell row."""
    if not isinstance(cell, dict):
        raise DoneManifestError("authority cell is not an object")
    return _canonical_sha256(cell)


def _identity(row: Any, where: str, problems: list[str]) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    if not isinstance(row, dict):
        problems.append(f"{where} is not an object")
        return None
    source = row.get("roster_source")
    slug = row.get("slug")
    if source not in ROSTER_SOURCES:
        problems.append(
            f"{where}.roster_source={source!r} is not one of {list(ROSTER_SOURCES)}")
    if not isinstance(slug, str) or not slug:
        problems.append(f"{where}.slug is not a nonempty string: {slug!r}")
    if source not in ROSTER_SOURCES or not isinstance(slug, str) or not slug:
        return None
    return source, slug


def chunk_membership_sha256(members: list[dict]) -> str:
    """Hash canonical, sorted ``(roster_source, slug)`` identities.

    Authority-row hashes deliberately are not part of this digest: they are
    sealed independently and the membership digest remains the exact matrix
    identity set requested by the chunk.
    """
    problems: list[str] = []
    identities = [
        identity for i, row in enumerate(members)
        if (identity := _identity(row, f"chunk_membership[{i}]", problems))
        is not None
    ]
    duplicates = sorted(k for k, n in Counter(identities).items() if n > 1)
    if duplicates:
        problems.append(f"duplicate chunk authority identities: {duplicates}")
    if not identities:
        problems.append("chunk membership must be nonempty")
    if problems:
        raise DoneManifestError("; ".join(problems))
    canonical = [
        {"roster_source": source, "slug": slug}
        for source, slug in sorted(identities)
    ]
    return _canonical_sha256(canonical)


def current_source_commit(repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT) -> str:
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True,
            cwd=str(repo_root),
        )
    except OSError:
        return ""
    return proc.stdout.strip() if proc.returncode == 0 else ""


def git_tree_clean(repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT) -> bool:
    """Return the real tree state; a failed git query is never called clean."""
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "status", "--porcelain", "-uall"], capture_output=True,
            text=True, cwd=str(repo_root),
        )
    except OSError:
        return False
    return proc.returncode == 0 and not proc.stdout.strip()


def _valid_relative_artifact_path(raw: Any) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw or "\\" in raw:
        return False
    path = PurePosixPath(raw)
    return (not path.is_absolute() and raw == path.as_posix()
            and path.as_posix() != "." and ".." not in path.parts)


def _normalize_membership(members: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    if not isinstance(members, list):
        raise DoneManifestError("chunk_membership is not an array")
    problems: list[str] = []
    normalized: list[dict] = []
    identities: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    for i, row in enumerate(members):
        identity = _identity(row, f"chunk_membership[{i}]", problems)
        authority_sha = row.get("authority_cell_sha256") if isinstance(row, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(authority_sha, str) or not _SHA64_RE.fullmatch(authority_sha):
            problems.append(
                f"chunk_membership[{i}].authority_cell_sha256 is not sha256: "
                f"{authority_sha!r}")
        if identity is not None:
            identities.append(identity)
            normalized.append({
                "roster_source": identity[0],
                "slug": identity[1],
                "authority_cell_sha256": authority_sha,
            })
    duplicates = sorted(k for k, n in Counter(identities).items() if n > 1)
    if duplicates:
        problems.append(f"duplicate chunk authority identities: {duplicates}")
    if not normalized:
        problems.append("chunk membership must be nonempty")
    if problems:
        raise DoneManifestError("; ".join(problems))
    return sorted(normalized, key=lambda r: (r["roster_source"], r["slug"]))


def _normalize_artifacts(artifacts: Any, where: str, problems: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    if not isinstance(artifacts, list):
        problems.append(f"{where} is not an array")
        return []
    normalized: list[dict] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    allowed = {"artifact_kind", "relative_path", "sha256", "size_bytes"}
    for i, artifact in enumerate(artifacts):
        label = f"{where}[{i}]"
        if not isinstance(artifact, dict):
            problems.append(f"{label} is not an object")
            continue
        unknown = sorted(set(artifact) - allowed)
        if unknown:
            problems.append(f"{label} has unknown fields {unknown}")
        kind = artifact.get("artifact_kind")
        rel = artifact.get("relative_path")
        sha = artifact.get("sha256")
        size = artifact.get("size_bytes")
        if kind not in ARTIFACT_KINDS:
            problems.append(
                f"{label}.artifact_kind={kind!r} is not one of {list(ARTIFACT_KINDS)}")
        if not _valid_relative_artifact_path(rel):
            problems.append(
                f"{label}.relative_path must stay beneath output_root: {rel!r}")
        elif rel in seen:
            problems.append(f"{where} has duplicate relative_path {rel!r}")
        else:
            seen.add(rel)
        if not isinstance(sha, str) or not _SHA64_RE.fullmatch(sha):
            problems.append(f"{label}.sha256 is not sha256: {sha!r}")
        if not isinstance(size, int) or isinstance(size, bool) or size < 0:
            problems.append(f"{label}.size_bytes is not a non-negative int: {size!r}")
        elif size == 0 and kind != "execution_log":
            problems.append(
                f"{label}.size_bytes must be positive for semantic artifact {kind!r}")
        normalized.append({
            "artifact_kind": kind,
            "relative_path": rel,
            "sha256": sha,
            "size_bytes": size,
        })
    return normalized


def _is_uuid4(raw: Any) -> bool:
    """Return whether ``raw`` is the canonical lower-case text of a UUID4."""
    if not isinstance(raw, str):
        return False
    try:
        parsed = uuid.UUID(raw)
    except (AttributeError, ValueError):
        return False
    return parsed.version == 4 and str(parsed) == raw


def _normalize_prior_preparation_failures(
    value: Any, *, where: str, problems: list[str],
) -> list[dict]:
    """Validate the closed active-journal back-reference representation."""
    if not isinstance(value, list):
        problems.append(f"{where} is not an array")
        return []
    normalized: list[dict] = []
    seen_ids: set[str] = set()
    for index, raw in enumerate(value):
        label = f"{where}[{index}]"
        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            problems.append(f"{label} is not an object")
            continue
        unknown = sorted(set(raw) - _PREPARATION_FAILURE_BACKREF_FIELDS)
        missing = sorted(_PREPARATION_FAILURE_BACKREF_FIELDS - set(raw))
        if unknown or missing:
            problems.append(
                f"{label} field set mismatch: missing={missing}, unknown={unknown}"
            )
        entry_id = raw.get("ledger_entry_id")
        ledger_raw = raw.get("ledger_path")
