        registry_payload=snapshot.payload,
        registry_sha256=snapshot.sha256,
    )
    assert rebound == snapshot

    with pytest.raises(
        bcm.MatrixBuildError, match="payload hash mismatch",
    ):
        bcm._metric_registry_snapshot(
            source,
            registry_document=snapshot.document,
            registry_payload=snapshot.payload,
            registry_sha256="0" * 64,
        )
    changed = copy.deepcopy(snapshot.document)
    changed["schema_version"] = 999
    with pytest.raises(
        bcm.MatrixBuildError, match="document does not match its exact payload",
    ):
        bcm._metric_registry_snapshot(
            source,
            registry_document=changed,
            registry_payload=snapshot.payload,
            registry_sha256=snapshot.sha256,
        )
    with pytest.raises(
        bcm.MatrixBuildError, match="must be supplied together",
    ):
        bcm._metric_registry_snapshot(
            source,
            registry_document=snapshot.document,
            registry_payload=None,
            registry_sha256=snapshot.sha256,
        )

    frozen = bcm._snapshot_json(_COMMITTED, role="frozen registry binding")
    assert "bound_metric_registry_invalid" in bcm.validate_matrix(
        frozen.document,
        _REPO,
        registry_document=snapshot.document,
        registry_payload=snapshot.payload,
        registry_sha256="0" * 64,
        matrix_snapshot=frozen,
    )


def test_bound_registry_build_never_reopens_ambient_path(monkeypatch):
    _permit_offline_successor_build(monkeypatch)
    source = bcm._lexical_absolute(_REPO / bcm.METRIC_REGISTRY_PATH)
    snapshot = bcm._snapshot_json(source, role="test bound registry")
    real_read = bcm.read_regular_file

    def guarded_read(path: Path) -> bytes:
        if bcm._lexical_absolute(path) == source:
            pytest.fail("bound registry path was reopened")
        return real_read(path)

    monkeypatch.setattr(bcm, "read_regular_file", guarded_read)
    generated = bcm.build_matrix(
        _REPO,
        require_head_match=False,
        registry_document=snapshot.document,
        registry_payload=snapshot.payload,
        registry_sha256=snapshot.sha256,
    )
    assert generated["input_pins"]["metric_registry"]["sha256"] == (
        snapshot.sha256
    )


def test_primary_json_semantics_and_hashes_share_one_snapshot(monkeypatch):
    _permit_offline_successor_build(monkeypatch)
    watched = {
        bcm._lexical_absolute(_REPO / relative): role
        for relative, role in (
            (bcm.AUTHORITY_PATH, "authority"),
            (bcm.PROTOCOL_PINS_PATH, "protocol_pins"),
            (bcm.RETENTION_BUDGET_PATH, "aggregate_retention_budget"),
            (bcm.METRIC_REGISTRY_PATH, "metric_registry"),
        )
    }
    real_read = bcm.read_regular_file
    real_hash = bcm.sha256_file
    calls = {path: 0 for path in watched}
    payloads: dict[Path, bytes] = {}

    def counted_read(path: Path) -> bytes:
        lexical = bcm._lexical_absolute(path)
        payload = real_read(path)
        if lexical in calls:
            calls[lexical] += 1
            payloads[lexical] = payload
        return payload

    def forbid_second_hash_open(path: Path) -> str:
        lexical = bcm._lexical_absolute(path)
        if lexical in watched:
            pytest.fail(f"separate hash open for {watched[lexical]}")
        return real_hash(path)

    monkeypatch.setattr(bcm, "read_regular_file", counted_read)
    monkeypatch.setattr(bcm, "sha256_file", forbid_second_hash_open)
    generated = bcm.build_matrix(_REPO, require_head_match=False)
    assert set(calls.values()) == {1}
    assert generated["authority"]["sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(
        payloads[bcm._lexical_absolute(_REPO / bcm.AUTHORITY_PATH)]
    ).hexdigest()
    for relative, pin_name in (
        (bcm.PROTOCOL_PINS_PATH, "protocol_pins"),
        (bcm.RETENTION_BUDGET_PATH, "aggregate_retention_budget"),
        (bcm.METRIC_REGISTRY_PATH, "metric_registry"),
    ):
        path = bcm._lexical_absolute(_REPO / relative)
        assert generated["input_pins"][pin_name]["sha256"] == (
            hashlib.sha256(payloads[path]).hexdigest()
        )

def test_matrix_output_is_noncanonical_exclusive_and_nofollow(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch,
):
    canonical = tmp_path / bcm.CANONICAL_MATRIX_PATH
    with pytest.raises(
        bcm.MatrixBuildError, match="noncanonical successor path",
    ):
        bcm._publish_matrix_exclusive(
            canonical, {"schema_version": 1}, repo_root=tmp_path,
        )
    assert not canonical.exists()

    successor = tmp_path / "successor" / "matrix.json"
    bcm._publish_matrix_exclusive(
        successor, {"schema_version": 1, "kind": "successor"},
        repo_root=tmp_path,
    )
    assert json.loads(successor.read_text()) == {
        "schema_version": 1, "kind": "successor",
    }
    assert successor.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o444

    existing = tmp_path / "existing.json"
    existing.write_bytes(b"preserve-existing")
    with pytest.raises(
        bcm.MatrixBuildError, match="exclusive matrix output",
    ):
        bcm._publish_matrix_exclusive(existing, {"replacement": True})
    assert existing.read_bytes() == b"preserve-existing"

    victim_root = tmp_path / "victim"
    victim_root.mkdir()
    linked_root = tmp_path / "linked"
    linked_root.symlink_to(victim_root, target_is_directory=True)
    with pytest.raises(bcm.MatrixBuildError):
        bcm._publish_matrix_exclusive(
            linked_root / "matrix.json", {"must_not_publish": True},
        )
    assert not (victim_root / "matrix.json").exists()

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        bcm, "build_matrix",
        lambda *_args, **_kwargs: pytest.fail(
            "canonical --out reached successor construction"
        ),
    )
    assert bcm.main(["--out", str(_COMMITTED)]) == 2


def test_runtime_module_hashing_streams_without_read_regular_buffer(
    tmp_path, monkeypatch,
):
    module = tmp_path / "runtime-module.so"
    payload = (b"runtime-module-block" * 131072) + b"end"
    module.write_bytes(payload)
    expected = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()

    def forbidden_buffer(_path: Path) -> bytes:
        pytest.fail("runtime module hash buffered through read_regular_file")

    monkeypatch.setattr(bcm, "read_regular_file", forbidden_buffer)
    assert bcm.sha256_file(module) == expected

def test_chunks_are_bounded_exact_one_time_runnable_partition(matrix):
    chunks = matrix["chunks"]
    assert chunks[0]["chunk_id"] == "portable_lcd-000-bootstrap"
    assert chunks[0]["cells"] == [{
        "roster_source": "portable_lcd", "slug": "silu_fwd_bf16_sm80",
    }]
    sol_bootstrap = next(
        chunk for chunk in chunks
        if chunk["chunk_id"] == "sol_execbench-000-bootstrap"
    )
    assert sol_bootstrap["cells"] == [{
        "roster_source": "sol_execbench", "slug": bcm.SOL_BOOTSTRAP_SLUG,
    }]
    assert len(chunks) == 18
    assert matrix["chunking"]["sol_bootstrap_identity"] == sol_bootstrap["cells"][0]
    assert all(1 <= len(chunk["cells"]) <= bcm.MAX_CHUNK_CELLS for chunk in chunks)
    members = [
        (identity["roster_source"], identity["slug"])
        for chunk in chunks for identity in chunk["cells"]
    ]
    runnable = {
        (cell["identity"]["roster_source"], cell["identity"]["slug"])
        for cell in matrix["cells"] if cell["disposition"] == "runnable"
    }
    excluded = {
        (cell["identity"]["roster_source"], cell["identity"]["slug"])
        for cell in matrix["cells"] if cell["disposition"] == "excluded"
    }
    assert len(members) == len(set(members)) == 122
    assert set(members) == runnable
    assert not (set(members) & excluded)
    for chunk in chunks:
        assert chunk["membership_sha256"] == bcm.canonical_sha256(chunk["cells"])

def test_strided_batched_vendor_control_dispatches_post_trace(matrix):
    cell = next(
        row for row in matrix["cells"]
        if row["identity"] == {
            "roster_source": "simbench_bw",
            "slug": "vendor_sgemm_strided_batched_cublas",
        }
    )
    budgets = cc.load_trace_budgets(cc.DEFAULT_CELL_BUDGETS)
    binary, invocation, _ = cc.validate_direct_cell(
        cell, cell_budgets=budgets,
    )
    assert binary == _REPO / invocation["executable_path"]

    wrong = copy.deepcopy(cell)
    wrong["control_bits"] = {
        "policy": "direct_executable",
        "input_path": invocation["executable_path"],
        "input_sha256": invocation["executable_sha256"],
    }
    with pytest.raises(cc.ChunkRefusal, match="control_policy_not_implemented"):
        cc.validate_direct_cell(wrong, cell_budgets=budgets)

        and cell["identity"]["roster_source"] == "sol_execbench"

    assert len(sol) == 74
    native = [
        cell for cell in sol
        if cell["invocation"]["logical_workload"]["workload_scope"] == "native"

    reduced = [
        cell for cell in sol
        if cell["invocation"]["logical_workload"]["workload_scope"]
        == bcm.SOL_REDUCED_SHAPE
    ]
    assert len(native) == 73
    assert [cell["identity"]["slug"] for cell in reduced] == [
        "problem_028_gqa_rotary_attention_core_backward",

        assert adapter["forwarded_argv"] == inv["trace_app_args"] == inv["label_app_args"]
        assert adapter["contract_version"] == 3
        assert adapter["shape_forwarded_to_target"] is False
        assert adapter["label_driver_bridge_status"] == "implemented"
        assert adapter["persistent_stage_status"] == "implemented"
        assert adapter["capture_request_environment"] == (
            "SOL_EXECBENCH_CAPTURE_REQUEST"

            "all_effective_workloads_passed_exact"

        }
        assert not any(
            token == "--shape-point" or token.startswith("--shape-point=")
            for token in adapter["forwarded_argv"]
        )
        assert cell["control_bits"] == {
            "policy": "post_trace_module_or_typed",
            "module_discovery": "nvbit_runtime_module_inventory",
            "required_outcomes": list(bcm.SOL_CONTROL_OUTCOMES),
            "static_rebind": bcm.SOL_STATIC_CONTROL_REBIND,
        }
        assert "input_path" not in cell["control_bits"]
        assert "sol_label_shape_bridge_not_implemented" not in (
            cell["capture_readiness"]["blocking_reasons"]
        )

    for cell in native:
        inv = cell["invocation"]
        logical = inv["logical_workload"]
        assert logical["value"] == bcm.SOL_NATIVE_SHAPE
        assert logical["workload_file"] == f"{logical['benchmark_dir']}/workload.jsonl"
        assert "reduced_workload_provenance" not in logical

        assert inv["trace_app_args"] == [
            logical["benchmark_dir"],

            "--json",
        ]

    cell = reduced[0]
    inv = cell["invocation"]
    logical = inv["logical_workload"]
    provenance = logical["reduced_workload_provenance"]
    assert logical["value"] == bcm.SOL_REDUCED_SHAPE
    assert logical["workload_file"] == provenance["reduced_workload_ref"]
    assert logical["workload_file"] == (

def test_sol_logical_workload_hashes_and_counts_rederive(matrix):
    sol = [
        cell for cell in matrix["cells"]
        if cell["disposition"] == "runnable"
        and cell["identity"]["roster_source"] == "sol_execbench"
    ]
    assert matrix["input_pins"]["sol_shrink_provenance"] == {
        "path": bcm.SOL_SHRINK_PROVENANCE_PATH.as_posix(),
        "sha256": bcm.sha256_file(_REPO / bcm.SOL_SHRINK_PROVENANCE_PATH),
    }
    assert matrix["input_pins"]["sol_runnability"] == {
        "path": bcm.SOL_RUNNABILITY_PATH.as_posix(),
        "sha256": bcm.sha256_file(_REPO / bcm.SOL_RUNNABILITY_PATH),
    }
    fingerprint = json.loads(
        (_REPO / bcm.SOL_NATIVE_ENV_FINGERPRINT_PATH).read_text()
    )
    assert matrix["input_pins"]["sol_native_env_fingerprint"] == {
        "path": bcm.SOL_NATIVE_ENV_FINGERPRINT_PATH.as_posix(),
        "sha256": bcm.sha256_file(
            _REPO / bcm.SOL_NATIVE_ENV_FINGERPRINT_PATH
        ),
        "native_env_hash": fingerprint["native_env_hash"],
    }
    assert fingerprint["native_env_hash"] == bcm.compute_native_env_hash(
        fingerprint["components"]
    )
    assert fingerprint["components"]["nvcc_ccbin"] == (
        bcm.SOL_PINNED_NVCC_CCBIN
    )
    for cell in sol:
        inv = cell["invocation"]
        logical = inv["logical_workload"]
        solution = _REPO / inv["authority_reference_path"]
        definition = _REPO / logical["definition_file"]
        benchmark = _REPO / logical["benchmark_dir"]
        workload = _REPO / logical["workload_file"]
        assert bcm.sha256_file(solution) == inv["authority_reference_sha256"]
        assert bcm.sha256_file(definition) == logical["definition_file_sha256"]
        assert bcm.tree_sha256(benchmark) == logical["benchmark_tree_sha256"]
        assert bcm.sha256_file(workload) == logical["workload_file_sha256"]
        assert bcm._count_workloads(workload) == logical["expected_workloads"]
        assert json.loads(solution.read_text())["definition"] == logical[
            "benchmark_definition"
        ]
        assert json.loads(definition.read_text())["name"] == logical[
            "benchmark_definition"
        ]


def test_sol_native_env_contract_rederives_exact_certified_fingerprint():
    contract = bcm._sol_native_env_contract(_REPO)
    artifact = json.loads(
        (_REPO / bcm.SOL_NATIVE_ENV_FINGERPRINT_PATH).read_text()
    )
    assert contract == {
        "source_sha256": bcm.sha256_file(
            _REPO / bcm.SOL_NATIVE_ENV_FINGERPRINT_PATH
        ),
        "native_env_hash": artifact["native_env_hash"],
        "components": artifact["components"],
    }
    assert contract["native_env_hash"] == bcm._sol_shrink_contract(
        _REPO
    )["native_env_hash"]
    assert contract["native_env_hash"] == bcm._sol_runnability_contract(
        _REPO
    )["native_env_hash"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("mutation", "error"),
    [
        ("hash_drift", "fingerprint hash mismatch"),
        ("degraded", "fingerprint is degraded"),
        ("component_set", "component set mismatch"),
        ("compiler_spelling", "compiler pin mismatch"),
    ],
)
def test_sol_native_env_contract_rejects_drift(mutation, error):
    source = bcm._lexical_absolute(
        _REPO / bcm.SOL_NATIVE_ENV_FINGERPRINT_PATH
    )
    doc = json.loads(source.read_text())
    if mutation == "hash_drift":
        doc["components"]["cudnn_version"] = "tampered"
    elif mutation == "degraded":
        doc["components"]["cudnn_version"] = "unknown"
        doc["missing_components"] = ["cudnn_version"]
        doc["degraded"] = True
        doc["native_env_hash"] = bcm.compute_native_env_hash(doc["components"])
    elif mutation == "component_set":
        del doc["components"]["c_compiler"]
    elif mutation == "compiler_spelling":
        doc["components"]["nvcc_ccbin"] = "/usr/bin/g++-14"
        doc["native_env_hash"] = bcm.compute_native_env_hash(doc["components"])
    else:  # pragma: no cover - parametrization is closed above
        raise AssertionError(mutation)
    payload = bcm.immutable.pretty_json_bytes(doc)
    snapshot = bcm._JsonInputSnapshot(
        path=source,
        payload=payload,
        sha256=hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
        document=doc,
    )
    with pytest.raises(bcm.MatrixBuildError, match=error):
        bcm._sol_native_env_contract(_REPO, snapshot=snapshot)


def test_sol_invocation_rejects_authority_fingerprint_disagreement():
    authority = json.loads((_REPO / bcm.AUTHORITY_PATH).read_text())
    cell = next(
        row for row in authority["cells"]
        if row["roster_source"] == "sol_execbench"
        and row["resolution_status"] == "runnable"
    )
    with pytest.raises(
        bcm.MatrixBuildError, match="fingerprint/native environment mismatch"
    ):
        bcm._sol_invocation(
            cell,
            _REPO,
            native_env_contract={"native_env_hash": "f" * 64},
        )


def test_full_registry_identity_has_no_silent_metric_omission(matrix):
    reg = matrix["metric_registry"]
    assert reg["metric_count"] == 61 == len(reg["metrics"])
    assert reg["metric_identity_sha256"] == bcm.canonical_sha256(reg["metrics"])
    keys = [metric["key"] for metric in reg["metrics"]]
    assert len(keys) == len(set(keys))
    selected = [m for m in reg["metrics"] if m["capture_status"] == "selected"]
    omitted = reg["collection"]["not_collected_registry_metrics"]
    assert len(selected) == reg["collection"]["selected_registry_metric_count"]
    assert len(selected) + len(omitted) == 61
    assert matrix["input_pins"]["metric_registry"]["sha256"] == bcm.sha256_file(
        _REPO / bcm.METRIC_REGISTRY_PATH
    )


def test_all_runnable_budgets_are_explicit_and_fit_retention_contract(matrix):
    assert matrix["input_pins"]["per_cell_trace_budgets"]["defaults_are_enforcement"] is False
    runnable = [cell for cell in matrix["cells"] if cell["disposition"] == "runnable"]
    missing = [cell for cell in runnable if cell["trace_budget"]["status"] == "missing"]
    declared = [cell for cell in runnable if cell["trace_budget"]["status"] == "declared"]
    assert missing == []
    assert len(declared) == len(runnable) == 122
    assert matrix["counts"]["budget_missing"] == 0
    assert matrix["counts"]["capture_ready"] == 122
    assert matrix["counts"]["capture_blocked"] == 0
    aggregate = matrix["input_pins"]["aggregate_retention_budget"]
    assert aggregate["declared_runnable_max_trace_bytes"] == sum(
        cell["trace_budget"]["max_trace_bytes"] for cell in runnable
    )
    assert aggregate["retained_headroom_bytes"] == (
        aggregate["retention_ceiling_bytes"]
        - aggregate["declared_runnable_max_trace_bytes"]
        - aggregate["metadata_margin_bytes"]
    )
    assert aggregate["retained_headroom_bytes"] >= 0
    assert aggregate["preflight_required_free_bytes"] == (
        aggregate["retention_ceiling_bytes"]
        + aggregate["raw_staging_margin_bytes"]
    )
    silu = next(
        cell for cell in runnable
        if cell["identity"] == {
            "roster_source": "portable_lcd", "slug": "silu_fwd_bf16_sm80",
        }
    )
    assert silu["trace_budget"]["status"] == "declared"
    assert silu["capture_readiness"]["status"] == "ready"


def test_histogram_wall_envelope_is_measured_and_cell_specific(matrix):
    portable = {
        cell["identity"]["slug"]: cell
        for cell in matrix["cells"]
        if cell["disposition"] == "runnable"

    }

        row["trace_budget"]["max_wall_time_s"]
        for slug, row in portable.items()
        if slug != "ac4_global_atomic_histogram"
    } == {3600}

def test_authority_guard_rejects_zero_mismatch_pending_and_stale(matrix):
    authority = json.loads((_REPO / bcm.AUTHORITY_PATH).read_text())
    empty = copy.deepcopy(authority)
    empty["cells"] = []
    empty["counts"]["universe"] = 0
    with pytest.raises(bcm.MatrixBuildError, match="zero cells"):
        bcm._authority_invariants(empty, repo_root=_REPO, require_head_match=False)

    mismatch = copy.deepcopy(authority)
    mismatch["counts"]["universe"] -= 1
    with pytest.raises(bcm.MatrixBuildError, match="universe mismatch"):
        bcm._authority_invariants(mismatch, repo_root=_REPO, require_head_match=False)

    pending = copy.deepcopy(authority)
    runnable = next(c for c in pending["cells"] if c["resolution_status"] == "runnable")
    runnable["resolution_status"] = "pending_build"
    pending["counts"]["runnable"] -= 1
    pending["counts"]["pending_build"] += 1
    with pytest.raises(bcm.MatrixBuildError, match="pending rows"):
        bcm._authority_invariants(pending, repo_root=_REPO, require_head_match=False)

    stale = copy.deepcopy(authority)
    stale["source_commit"] = "0" * 40
    with pytest.raises(bcm.MatrixBuildError, match="stale authority"):
        bcm._authority_invariants(stale, repo_root=_REPO, require_head_match=True)

        )


def test_sol_bridge_rejects_wrong_definition_binding(monkeypatch):
    authority = json.loads((_REPO / bcm.AUTHORITY_PATH).read_text())
    native = next(
        cell for cell in authority["cells"]
        if cell["roster_source"] == "sol_execbench"
        and cell["resolution_status"] == "runnable"
        and cell["shape_point"] == bcm.SOL_NATIVE_SHAPE
    )
    contract = bcm._sol_shrink_contract(_REPO)
    real_snapshot = bcm._snapshot_json
    solution_doc = real_snapshot(
        _REPO / native["binary"], role="test solution",
    ).document
    definition_path = bcm._lexical_absolute(
        _REPO / bcm.SOL_BENCHMARK_ROOT
        / bcm.SOL_SUBSET_MAP[native["category"]]
        / solution_doc["definition"] / "definition.json"
    )

    def wrong_definition(path: Path, *, role: str):
        snapshot = real_snapshot(path, role=role)
        if bcm._lexical_absolute(path) != definition_path:
            return snapshot
        value = copy.deepcopy(snapshot.document)
        value["name"] = "wrong_definition"
        payload = bcm.immutable.pretty_json_bytes(value)
        return bcm._JsonInputSnapshot(
            path=snapshot.path,
            payload=payload,
            sha256=hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
            document=value,
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(bcm, "_snapshot_json", wrong_definition)
    with pytest.raises(bcm.MatrixBuildError, match="solution/benchmark definition mismatch"):
        bcm._sol_invocation(native, _REPO, shrink_contract=contract)


def test_sol_bridge_rejects_reduced_to_native_misroute_and_fake_shape_token():

            ident={"roster_source": "sol_execbench", "slug": "fake"},
        )


def test_schema_and_semantics_reject_missing_or_faked_invocation(matrix):
    missing = copy.deepcopy(matrix)
    row = next(cell for cell in missing["cells"] if cell["disposition"] == "runnable")
    del row["invocation"]
    _reseal(missing)
    with pytest.raises(jsonschema.ValidationError):
        jsonschema.validate(missing, _SCHEMA)

    fake_sol = copy.deepcopy(matrix)
    sol = next(
        cell for cell in fake_sol["cells"]
        if cell["disposition"] == "runnable"
        and cell["identity"]["roster_source"] == "sol_execbench"
    )
    sol["control_bits"] = {
        "policy": "direct_executable",
        "input_path": sol["invocation"]["authority_reference_path"],
        "input_sha256": sol["invocation"]["authority_reference_sha256"],
    }
    _reseal(fake_sol)
    with pytest.raises(jsonschema.ValidationError):
        jsonschema.validate(fake_sol, _SCHEMA)

    missing_static_rebind = copy.deepcopy(matrix)
    sol = next(
        cell for cell in missing_static_rebind["cells"]
        if cell["disposition"] == "runnable"
        and cell["identity"]["roster_source"] == "sol_execbench"
    )
    del sol["control_bits"]["static_rebind"]
    _reseal(missing_static_rebind)
    with pytest.raises(jsonschema.ValidationError):
        jsonschema.validate(missing_static_rebind, _SCHEMA)

    for slug in bcm.VENDOR_RUNTIME_CONTROL_CONTRACTS:
        fake_vendor = copy.deepcopy(matrix)
        vendor = next(
            cell for cell in fake_vendor["cells"]
            if cell["identity"] == {
                "roster_source": "simbench_bw", "slug": slug,
            }
        )
        vendor["control_bits"] = {
            "policy": "direct_executable",
            "input_path": vendor["invocation"]["executable_path"],
            "input_sha256": vendor["invocation"]["executable_sha256"],
        }
        _reseal(fake_vendor)
        with pytest.raises(jsonschema.ValidationError):
            jsonschema.validate(fake_vendor, _SCHEMA)

    direct_sol = copy.deepcopy(matrix)
    sol = next(
        cell for cell in direct_sol["cells"]
        if cell["disposition"] == "runnable"
        and cell["identity"]["roster_source"] == "sol_execbench"
    )
    invocation = sol["invocation"]
    invocation["adapter_kind"] = "direct_binary"
    invocation["shape_delivery"] = "application_args"
    invocation["trace_cardinality_contract"] = "authority_args_exact"
    invocation["logical_workload"] = {"kind": "shape_point", "value": "workloads"}
    del invocation["adapter_contract"]
    _reseal(direct_sol)
    with pytest.raises(jsonschema.ValidationError):
        jsonschema.validate(direct_sol, _SCHEMA)

    missing_override = copy.deepcopy(matrix)
    overridden = next(
        cell for cell in missing_override["cells"]
        if cell["identity"]["slug"] == "cp_async_shared_tile_copy"
    )
    del overridden["invocation"]["matrix_capture_override"]
    _reseal(missing_override)
    with pytest.raises(jsonschema.ValidationError):
        jsonschema.validate(missing_override, _SCHEMA)

    extra_override = copy.deepcopy(matrix)
    ordinary = next(
        cell for cell in extra_override["cells"]
        if cell["disposition"] == "runnable"
        and cell["identity"]["roster_source"] == "simbench_bw"
        and cell["identity"]["slug"] not in bcm.SIMBENCH_CAPTURE_OVERRIDES
    )
    ordinary["invocation"]["matrix_capture_override"] = copy.deepcopy(
        overridden.get("invocation", {}).get("matrix_capture_override")
        or next(
            cell for cell in matrix["cells"]
            if cell["identity"]["slug"] == "cp_async_shared_tile_copy"
        )["invocation"]["matrix_capture_override"]
    )
    _reseal(extra_override)
    with pytest.raises(jsonschema.ValidationError):
        jsonschema.validate(extra_override, _SCHEMA)

    bad_sequence = copy.deepcopy(matrix)
    warm = next(
        cell for cell in bad_sequence["cells"]
        if cell["identity"]["slug"] == "warm_cold_pair_relaunch"
    )
    warm["invocation"]["capture_launch_contract"]["trace_launch_sequence"].reverse()
    _reseal(bad_sequence)
    assert "matrix_content_stale_or_tampered" in bcm.validate_matrix(
        bad_sequence, _REPO
    )

    mislabeled_vendor_shape = copy.deepcopy(matrix)
    vendor = next(
        cell for cell in mislabeled_vendor_shape["cells"]
        if cell["identity"] == {
            "roster_source": "simbench_bw", "slug": "vendor_gemm_cublas",
        }
    )
    vendor["invocation"]["logical_workload"]["value"] = "trace_00"
    _reseal(mislabeled_vendor_shape)
    assert "matrix_content_stale_or_tampered" in bcm.validate_matrix(
        mislabeled_vendor_shape, _REPO
    )

    missing_fingerprint_pin = copy.deepcopy(matrix)
    del missing_fingerprint_pin["input_pins"]["sol_native_env_fingerprint"]
    _reseal(missing_fingerprint_pin)
    with pytest.raises(jsonschema.ValidationError):
        jsonschema.validate(missing_fingerprint_pin, _SCHEMA)

    missing_compiler_pin = copy.deepcopy(matrix)
    sol = next(
        cell for cell in missing_compiler_pin["cells"]
        if cell["disposition"] == "runnable"
        and cell["identity"]["roster_source"] == "sol_execbench"
    )
    del sol["invocation"]["adapter_contract"]["environment"]["NVCC_CCBIN"]
    _reseal(missing_compiler_pin)
    with pytest.raises(jsonschema.ValidationError):
        jsonschema.validate(missing_compiler_pin, _SCHEMA)

def test_resealed_pin_or_chunk_tamper_is_detected(matrix):
    stale = copy.deepcopy(matrix)
    stale["authority"]["sha256"] = "f" * 64
    _reseal(stale)
    assert "matrix_content_stale_or_tampered" in bcm.validate_matrix(stale, _REPO)

    stale_fingerprint = copy.deepcopy(matrix)
    stale_fingerprint["input_pins"]["sol_native_env_fingerprint"][
        "sha256"
    ] = "e" * 64
    _reseal(stale_fingerprint)
    assert "matrix_content_stale_or_tampered" in bcm.validate_matrix(
        stale_fingerprint, _REPO
    )

    duplicate = copy.deepcopy(matrix)
    duplicate["chunks"][1]["cells"][0] = copy.deepcopy(duplicate["chunks"][0]["cells"][0])
    duplicate["chunks"][1]["membership_sha256"] = bcm.canonical_sha256(
        duplicate["chunks"][1]["cells"]
    )
    duplicate["chunking"]["runnable_membership_sha256"] = bcm.canonical_sha256([
        member for chunk in duplicate["chunks"] for member in chunk["cells"]
    ])
    _reseal(duplicate)
    problems = bcm.validate_matrix(duplicate, _REPO)
    assert "chunk_membership_uniqueness" in problems
    assert "chunk_runnable_set_equality" in problems

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run one immutable sm_86 reference-capture chunk.

The full-roster matrix is the authority for chunk membership and invocation.
This consumer refuses stale inputs, a dirty/moved repository, an unadmitted
preflight, active competing capture processes, clock drift, binary drift,
empty/vacuously-valid traces, incomplete full-registry labels, and unsealed
artifacts.  Work is staged outside the repository and atomically renamed only
after the exact DONE manifest verifies; an existing finalized chunk is skipped
only after the same verifier rehashes it.

Direct executables and SOL-ExecBench workloads use distinct, fail-closed
adapters.  A SOL solution JSON remains a pinned workload reference rather than
being mistaken for either the profiled launcher or a static control binary.
"""

class ChunkRefusal(RuntimeError):
    """Fail-closed campaign refusal with a stable machine-readable code."""

    def __init__(self, code: str, detail: str):
        self.code = code
        self.detail = detail
        super().__init__(f"{code}: {detail}")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _RegularFileSnapshot:
    """Exact bytes from one shared anchored no-follow regular-file read."""

    path: Path
    payload: bytes
    sha256: str

    @property
    def size_bytes(self) -> int:
        return len(self.payload)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BoundMetricRegistry:
    """Matrix-authenticated registry bytes and their parsed authority."""

    snapshot: _RegularFileSnapshot
    document: dict[str, Any]
    registry: Any


def _lexical_absolute_path(path: Path) -> Path:
    candidate = Path(path)
    if not candidate.is_absolute():
        candidate = Path.cwd() / candidate
    if ".." in candidate.parts or not candidate.name:
        raise ValueError(f"path is not a lexical absolute leaf: {path}")
    return candidate


def _open_parent_directory_nofollow(path: Path) -> tuple[Path, int]:
    """Open every ancestor from ``/`` without following a symlink."""
    absolute = _lexical_absolute_path(path)
    nofollow = getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", None)
    if nofollow is None:
        raise OSError(errno.ENOTSUP, "O_NOFOLLOW is unavailable")
    flags = (
        os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | nofollow
        | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
    )
    directory_fd = os.open("/", flags)
    try:
        for component in absolute.parts[1:-1]:
            child_fd = os.open(
                component, flags, dir_fd=directory_fd,
            )
            os.close(directory_fd)
            directory_fd = child_fd
        return absolute, directory_fd
    except BaseException:
        os.close(directory_fd)
        raise


def _output_identity(observed: os.stat_result) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    return (
        int(observed.st_dev), int(observed.st_ino), int(observed.st_mode),
        int(observed.st_nlink), int(observed.st_size),
        int(observed.st_mtime_ns), int(observed.st_ctime_ns),
    )


def _read_regular_snapshot(
    path: Path, *, artifact: str,
    storage_code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure",
    operation: str,
) -> _RegularFileSnapshot:
    """Read one stable regular file through the shared pinned public API."""
    absolute = _lexical_absolute_path(path)
    try:
        payload = immutable.read_regular(absolute)
    except immutable.ImmutableArtifactError as exc:
        storage_origin = _storage_origin(exc)
        if storage_origin is not None:
            _raise_typed_storage_failure(
                storage_origin, code=storage_code, operation=operation,
            )
        detail = str(exc)
        code = (
            f"{artifact}_snapshot_race"
            if "changed" in detail
            else f"{artifact}_snapshot_invalid"
        )
        raise ChunkRefusal(code, f"{absolute}: {detail}") from exc
    return _RegularFileSnapshot(
        path=absolute,
        payload=payload,
        sha256=immutable.sha256_bytes(payload),
    )


def _assert_snapshot_still_current(
    snapshot: _RegularFileSnapshot, *, artifact: str,
    storage_code: str = "cell_inventory_storage_failure",
    operation: str,
) -> None:
    observed = _read_regular_snapshot(
        snapshot.path, artifact=artifact, storage_code=storage_code,
        operation=operation,
    )
    if (
        observed.sha256 != snapshot.sha256
        or observed.payload != snapshot.payload
    ):
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            f"{artifact}_identity_drift",
            f"validation-time artifact changed before inventory: {snapshot.path}",
        )


def _strict_json_object(
    snapshot: _RegularFileSnapshot, *, artifact: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Decode one object through the shared strict JSON authority."""
    try:
        value = immutable.strict_json_loads(
            snapshot.payload, label=str(snapshot.path),
        )
    except immutable.ImmutableArtifactError as exc:
        detail = str(exc)
        if "duplicate JSON key" in detail:
            suffix = "duplicate_key"
        elif "non-finite JSON number" in detail:
            suffix = "nonfinite_json"
        elif "not UTF-8" in detail:
            suffix = "invalid_utf8"
        else:
            suffix = "json_invalid"
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            f"{artifact}_{suffix}", f"{snapshot.path}: {detail}",
        ) from exc
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            f"{artifact}_not_object", f"{snapshot.path} root is not an object",
        )
    return value


def bind_matrix_metric_registry(
    matrix: dict[str, Any], registry_path: Path,
) -> BoundMetricRegistry:
    """Read/hash/parse the exact matrix-authorized registry bytes once."""
    pin = ((matrix.get("input_pins") or {}).get("metric_registry") or {})
    pinned_value = pin.get("path")
    expected_sha256 = pin.get("sha256")
    if (
        not isinstance(pinned_value, str) or not pinned_value
        or not isinstance(expected_sha256, str)
        or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", expected_sha256) is None
    ):
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "matrix_metric_registry_pin_invalid", repr(pin),
        )
    try:
        actual = _lexical_absolute_path(registry_path)
        pinned = _lexical_absolute_path(
            Path(pinned_value)
            if Path(pinned_value).is_absolute()
            else REPO_ROOT / pinned_value
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "matrix_metric_registry_path_invalid", str(exc),
        ) from exc
    if actual != pinned:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "input_path_mismatch",
            f"metric registry: matrix={pinned}, CLI={actual}",
        )
    snapshot = _read_regular_snapshot(
        actual, artifact="matrix_metric_registry",
        storage_code="matrix_metric_registry_storage_failure",
        operation="matrix_metric_registry_snapshot",
    )
    if snapshot.sha256 != expected_sha256:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "input_hash_mismatch",
            f"metric registry: expected {expected_sha256}, observed "
            f"{snapshot.sha256}: {actual}",
        )
    document = _strict_json_object(
        snapshot, artifact="matrix_metric_registry",
    )
    try:
        parsed = metric_registry_lib.parse_registry(document)
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "matrix_metric_registry_invalid", str(exc),
        ) from exc
    return BoundMetricRegistry(
        snapshot=snapshot, document=document, registry=parsed,
    )


_STORAGE_FAILURE_ERRNOS = frozenset({
    errno.ENOSPC,
    errno.EDQUOT,
    errno.EIO,
    errno.EROFS,
    *(
        value for value in (
            getattr(errno, "ENXIO", None),
            getattr(errno, "ESTALE", None),
        ) if value is not None
    ),
})
LABEL_DRIVER_STORAGE_MARKER = "LABEL_DRIVER_STORAGE_FAILURE:"


def _storage_origin(exc: BaseException | None) -> OSError | None:
    """Return the closed storage-origin error through nested wrappers."""
    current = exc
    while current is not None:
        if isinstance(current, OSError) and current.errno in (
            _STORAGE_FAILURE_ERRNOS
        ):
            return current
        current = current.__cause__ or current.__context__
    return None


def _is_explicit_output_storage_refusal(exc: BaseException | None) -> bool:
    return (
        isinstance(exc, ChunkRefusal)
        and (
            exc.code.endswith("_storage_failure")
            or exc.code.endswith("_storage_monitor_failed")
        )
    )


def _raise_typed_storage_failure(
    exc: OSError, *, code: str, operation: str,
) -> None:
    """Raise a canonical typed refusal only for the closed storage errnos."""
    origin = _storage_origin(exc)
    if origin is None and exc.errno is None:
        # Only callers at an explicit output mutation boundary use this
        # helper; a short/errno-less write is therefore integrity failure.
        origin = exc
    if origin is not None:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            code, f"operation={operation}; errno={origin.errno}; {origin}",
        ) from origin


def _label_driver_storage_error(stderr: bytes) -> OSError | None:
    """Parse one explicit child output-storage marker, never arbitrary errno."""
    matches = [
        line[len(LABEL_DRIVER_STORAGE_MARKER):]
        for line in stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
        if line.startswith(LABEL_DRIVER_STORAGE_MARKER)
    ]
    if len(matches) != 1:
        return None
    try:
        value = json.loads(matches[0])
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return None
    if (
        not isinstance(value, dict)
        or set(value) != {"schema_version", "errno", "operation"}
        or value.get("schema_version") != 1
        or value.get("errno") not in _STORAGE_FAILURE_ERRNOS
        or value.get("operation") != "label_driver_output_probe"
    ):
        return None
    return OSError(value["errno"], "label driver reported output storage failure")


def _mkdir_output(
    path: Path, *, parents: bool, exist_ok: bool,
    code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure", operation: str,
) -> None:
    directory_fd: int | None = None
    try:
        absolute = _lexical_absolute_path(path / ".mkdir-leaf").parent
        flags = (
            os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW")
            | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
        )
        directory_fd = os.open("/", flags)
        components = absolute.parts[1:]
        for index, component in enumerate(components):
            final = index == len(components) - 1
            try:
                child_fd = os.open(
                    component, flags, dir_fd=directory_fd,
                )
                if final and not exist_ok:
                    os.close(child_fd)
                    raise FileExistsError(errno.EEXIST, "directory exists", str(path))
            except FileNotFoundError:
                if not parents and not final:
                    raise
                os.mkdir(component, 0o700, dir_fd=directory_fd)
                child_fd = os.open(
                    component, flags, dir_fd=directory_fd,
                )
            os.close(directory_fd)
            directory_fd = child_fd
    except OSError as exc:
        _raise_typed_storage_failure(exc, code=code, operation=operation)
        raise
    finally:
        if directory_fd is not None:
            try:
                os.close(directory_fd)
            except OSError:
                pass


def _write_output_bytes(
    path: Path, payload: bytes, *,
    code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure", operation: str,
) -> None:
    """Publish+fsync one new no-follow output without truncating a leaf."""
    directory_fd: int | None = None
    descriptor: int | None = None
    verification_directory_fd: int | None = None
    try:
        absolute, directory_fd = _open_parent_directory_nofollow(path)
        descriptor = os.open(
            absolute.name,
            os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL
            | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW") | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0),
            0o600,
            dir_fd=directory_fd,
        )
        view = memoryview(payload)
        while view:
            written = os.write(descriptor, view)
            if written <= 0:
                raise OSError(None, "short capture output write")
            view = view[written:]
        os.fsync(descriptor)
        opened = os.fstat(descriptor)
        named = os.stat(
            absolute.name, dir_fd=directory_fd, follow_symlinks=False,
        )
        verification_absolute, verification_directory_fd = (
            _open_parent_directory_nofollow(absolute)
        )
        verification_named = os.stat(
            verification_absolute.name,
            dir_fd=verification_directory_fd,
            follow_symlinks=False,
        )
        first_parent = os.fstat(directory_fd)
        verification_parent = os.fstat(verification_directory_fd)
        if (
            verification_absolute != absolute
            or not stat.S_ISREG(opened.st_mode)
            or opened.st_nlink != 1
            or _output_identity(opened) != _output_identity(named)
            or _output_identity(opened) != _output_identity(verification_named)
            or (
                first_parent.st_dev, first_parent.st_ino,
                stat.S_IFMT(first_parent.st_mode),
            ) != (
                verification_parent.st_dev, verification_parent.st_ino,
                stat.S_IFMT(verification_parent.st_mode),
            )
        ):
            raise OSError(errno.EIO, "capture output identity changed")
        os.fsync(directory_fd)
    except OSError as exc:
        _raise_typed_storage_failure(exc, code=code, operation=operation)
        raise
    finally:
        for opened_fd in (
            verification_directory_fd, descriptor, directory_fd,
        ):
            if opened_fd is not None:
                try:
                    os.close(opened_fd)
                except OSError:
                    pass


def _write_output_text(
    path: Path, payload: str, *,
    code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure", operation: str,
) -> None:
    _write_output_bytes(
        path, payload.encode("utf-8"), code=code, operation=operation,
    )


def _replace_output(
    source: Path, destination: Path, *,
    code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure", operation: str,
) -> None:
    try:
        os.replace(source, destination)
    except OSError as exc:
        _raise_typed_storage_failure(exc, code=code, operation=operation)
        raise


def _rmtree_output(
    path: Path, *, code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure",
    operation: str,
) -> None:
    try:
        shutil.rmtree(path)
    except OSError as exc:
        _raise_typed_storage_failure(exc, code=code, operation=operation)
        raise


def _link_output(
    source: Path, destination: Path, *,
    code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure", operation: str,
) -> None:
    source_directory_fd: int | None = None
    destination_directory_fd: int | None = None
    try:
        source_absolute, source_directory_fd = (
            _open_parent_directory_nofollow(source)
        )
        destination_absolute, destination_directory_fd = (
            _open_parent_directory_nofollow(destination)
        )
        os.link(
            source_absolute.name,
            destination_absolute.name,
            src_dir_fd=source_directory_fd,
            dst_dir_fd=destination_directory_fd,
            follow_symlinks=False,
        )
    except OSError as exc:
        _raise_typed_storage_failure(exc, code=code, operation=operation)
        raise
    finally:
        for opened_fd in (destination_directory_fd, source_directory_fd):
            if opened_fd is not None:
                try:
                    os.close(opened_fd)
                except OSError:
                    pass


def _chmod_output(
    path: Path, mode: int, *, code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure",
    operation: str,
) -> None:
    try:
        path.chmod(mode)
    except OSError as exc:
        _raise_typed_storage_failure(exc, code=code, operation=operation)
        raise


def _unlink_output(
    path: Path, *, missing_ok: bool,
    code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure", operation: str,
) -> None:
    directory_fd: int | None = None
    try:
        absolute, directory_fd = _open_parent_directory_nofollow(path)
        os.unlink(absolute.name, dir_fd=directory_fd)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        if not missing_ok:
            raise
    except OSError as exc:
        _raise_typed_storage_failure(exc, code=code, operation=operation)
        raise
    finally:
        if directory_fd is not None:
            try:
                os.close(directory_fd)
            except OSError:
                pass


def _copy_output_file(
    source: Path, destination: Path, *, exclusive: bool,
    code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure", operation: str,
) -> None:
    """Stream input to one output while keeping input read errors untyped."""
    source_stream = source.open("rb")
    active_error: BaseException | None = None
    try:
        try:
            destination_stream = destination.open("xb" if exclusive else "wb")
        except OSError as exc:
            _raise_typed_storage_failure(
                exc, code=code, operation=f"{operation}_open",
            )
            raise
        destination_error: BaseException | None = None
        try:
            while True:
                # This is an input read.  It deliberately remains outside an
                # output-error catch so EIO here cannot create a storage receipt.
                block = source_stream.read(1 << 20)
                if not block:
                    break
                try:
                    written = destination_stream.write(block)
                    if written != len(block):
                        raise OSError(None, "short capture output copy write")
                except OSError as exc:
                    _raise_typed_storage_failure(
                        exc, code=code, operation=f"{operation}_write",
                    )
                    raise
            try:
                destination_stream.flush()
                os.fsync(destination_stream.fileno())
            except OSError as exc:
                _raise_typed_storage_failure(
                    exc, code=code, operation=f"{operation}_fsync",
                )
                raise
        except BaseException as exc:
            destination_error = exc
            raise
        finally:
            try:
                destination_stream.close()
            except OSError as exc:
                if destination_error is None:
                    _raise_typed_storage_failure(
                        exc, code=code, operation=f"{operation}_close",
                    )
                    raise
                # Never let a secondary close fault replace the first output
                # failure (or promote an active raw input-read failure).
    except BaseException as exc:
        active_error = exc
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            source_stream.close()
        except OSError:
            if active_error is None:
                # Source close belongs to the input side and remains raw.
                raise


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _read_output_bytes(
    path: Path, *, code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure",
    operation: str,
) -> bytes:
    """Read a campaign-produced artifact with closed storage typing."""
    try:
        return path.read_bytes()
    except OSError as exc:
        _raise_typed_storage_failure(exc, code=code, operation=operation)
        raise


def _json_output(
    path: Path, *, code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure",
    operation: str,
) -> dict:
    value = json.loads(_read_output_bytes(
        path, code=code, operation=operation,
    ))
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ChunkRefusal("input_not_object", f"{path} root is not an object")
    return value


def _sha256_output_file(
    path: Path, *, code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure",
    operation: str,
) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    try:
        with path.open("rb") as stream:
            for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
                digest.update(block)
    except OSError as exc:
        _raise_typed_storage_failure(exc, code=code, operation=operation)
        raise
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _output_lstat(
    path: Path, *, code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure",
    operation: str,
) -> os.stat_result | None:
    try:
        return path.lstat()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    except OSError as exc:
        _raise_typed_storage_failure(exc, code=code, operation=operation)
        raise


def _output_tree_paths(
    root: Path, *, code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure",
    operation: str, pattern: str = "*",
) -> list[Path]:
    """Walk an output tree without pathlib's suppressed scandir failures."""
    paths: list[Path] = []

    def walk(directory: Path) -> None:
        try:
            with os.scandir(directory) as entries:
                observed = sorted(entries, key=lambda entry: entry.name)
        except OSError as exc:
            _raise_typed_storage_failure(
                exc, code=code, operation=f"{operation}_scandir",
            )
            raise
        for entry in observed:
            path = Path(entry.path)
            if Path(entry.name).match(pattern):
                paths.append(path)
            try:
                is_directory = entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False)
            except OSError as exc:
                _raise_typed_storage_failure(
                    exc, code=code, operation=f"{operation}_entry_stat",
                )
                raise
            if is_directory:
                walk(path)

    walk(root)
    return paths


def _resolve_output_path(
    path: Path, *, code: str = "capture_output_storage_failure",
    operation: str, strict: bool = True,
) -> Path:
    try:
        return path.resolve(strict=strict)
    except OSError as exc:
        _raise_typed_storage_failure(exc, code=code, operation=operation)
        raise


def _read_owned_regular_nofollow(path: Path, *, role: str) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    """Read one immutable external input without following any path symlink."""
    absolute = Path(path).absolute()
    if not absolute.is_absolute() or ".." in absolute.parts:
        raise ChunkRefusal("input_path_unreadable", f"{role}: {path}")
    directory_flags = (
        os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
        | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0)
    )
    directory_fd = os.open("/", directory_flags)
    descriptor: int | None = None
    try:
        for component in absolute.parts[1:-1]:
            child = os.open(component, directory_flags, dir_fd=directory_fd)
            os.close(directory_fd)
            directory_fd = child
        descriptor = os.open(
            absolute.name,
            os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0)
            | getattr(os, "O_CLOEXEC", 0),
            dir_fd=directory_fd,
        )
        observed = os.fstat(descriptor)
        if (
            not stat.S_ISREG(observed.st_mode)
            or observed.st_uid != os.geteuid()
            or observed.st_nlink != 1
            or observed.st_mode & 0o222
        ):
            raise ChunkRefusal(
                "sol_external_workload_not_immutable", f"{role}: {absolute}"
            )
        chunks: list[bytes] = []
        while True:
            block = os.read(descriptor, 1 << 20)
            if not block:
                break
            chunks.append(block)
        return b"".join(chunks), observed
    except OSError as exc:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "sol_external_workload_path_invalid", f"{role}: {absolute}: {exc}"
        ) from exc
    finally:
        if descriptor is not None:
            os.close(descriptor)
        os.close(directory_fd)


def canonical_sha256(value: Any) -> str:
    try:
        return immutable.sha256_bytes(immutable.canonical_json_bytes(value))
    except immutable.ImmutableArtifactError as exc:
        raise ValueError(str(exc)) from exc


def _json_exact_equal(left: Any, right: Any) -> bool:
    if type(left) is not type(right):
        return False
    if isinstance(left, dict):
        return (
            set(left) == set(right)
            and all(_json_exact_equal(left[key], right[key]) for key in left)
        )
    if isinstance(left, list):
        return (
            len(left) == len(right)
            and all(
                _json_exact_equal(left_item, right_item)
                for left_item, right_item in zip(left, right, strict=True)
            )
        )
    return left == right


def _json(path: Path) -> dict:
    value = json.loads(path.read_text())
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ChunkRefusal("input_not_object", f"{path} root is not an object")
    return value


def _resolve_repo_path(value: str, role: str) -> Path:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
        raise ChunkRefusal("input_path_missing", f"{role} path is absent")
    path = Path(value)
    path = path if path.is_absolute() else REPO_ROOT / path
    try:
        resolved = path.resolve(strict=True)
    except OSError as exc:
        raise ChunkRefusal("input_path_unreadable", f"{role}: {path}: {exc}") from exc
    return resolved


def _require_hash(path: Path, expected: str, role: str) -> None:
    actual = sha256_file(path)
    if actual != expected:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "input_hash_mismatch", f"{role}: expected {expected}, observed {actual}: {path}"
        )


def _git_state(repo_root: Path = REPO_ROOT) -> tuple[str, bool, str]:
    head = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=repo_root,
        capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    status = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "status", "--porcelain", "-uall"], cwd=repo_root,
        capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    if head.returncode != 0 or status.returncode != 0:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "git_state_unavailable",
            f"rev-parse rc={head.returncode}; status rc={status.returncode}",
        )
    dirty = status.stdout.strip()
    return head.stdout.strip(), not dirty, dirty


def _is_sha40(value: Any) -> bool:
    return isinstance(value, str) and len(value) == 40 and set(value) <= _SHA40


def _parse_utc_timestamp(value: Any, *, field: str) -> datetime:
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(
            value[:-1] + "+00:00"
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.endswith("Z")
            else value
        )
    except (TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError) as exc:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "preflight_invalid", f"{field} is invalid: {value!r} ({exc})"
        ) from exc
    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "preflight_invalid", f"{field} has no timezone: {value!r}"
        )
    return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc)


def validate_preflight_manifest(
    manifest: dict, *, expected_head: str, expected_pins_sha256: str,
    expected_output_root: Path, expected_budget_sha256: str | None = None,
    expected_arch: str = "sm_86", expected_sku: str = "rtx_3090_ti",
    expected_protocol: str = "v2.1",
    expected_matrix_sha256: str | None = None,
    expected_sol_fingerprint_pin: dict | None = None,
    require_fresh: bool = True,
    admitted_at_utc: datetime | None = None,
) -> None:
    problems: list[str] = []
    try:
        import jsonschema
        schema = json.loads(
            (REPO_ROOT / "workloads" / "simbench_bw" / "schemas"
             / "campaign_preflight_manifest.schema.json").read_text()
        )
        jsonschema.validate(manifest, schema)
    except Exception as exc:
        problems.append(f"schema validation failed: {exc}")
    if manifest.get("capture_admitted") is not True:
        problems.append("capture_admitted is not true")
    if manifest.get("working_tree_clean") is not True:
        problems.append("working_tree_clean is not true")
    if manifest.get("git_head") != expected_head:
        problems.append(
            f"git_head={manifest.get('git_head')!r} != {expected_head!r}"
        )
    if manifest.get("pins_sha256") != expected_pins_sha256:
        problems.append("pins_sha256 does not match the matrix")
    if (
        expected_matrix_sha256 is not None
        and manifest.get("capture_matrix_sha256") != expected_matrix_sha256
    ):
        problems.append("capture_matrix_sha256 does not match the matrix")
    if manifest.get("arch") != expected_arch:
        problems.append(f"arch={manifest.get('arch')!r} != {expected_arch!r}")
    if manifest.get("sku") != expected_sku:
        problems.append(f"sku={manifest.get('sku')!r} != {expected_sku!r}")
    if manifest.get("protocol_version") != expected_protocol:
        problems.append(
            f"protocol_version={manifest.get('protocol_version')!r} "
            f"!= {expected_protocol!r}"
        )
    if manifest.get("blockers") != []:
        problems.append(f"blockers is not empty: {manifest.get('blockers')!r}")
    generated_raw = manifest.get("generated_at_utc")
    captured_raw = manifest.get("captured_at_utc")
    if generated_raw != captured_raw:
        problems.append("generated_at_utc and captured_at_utc differ")
    checks = manifest.get("checks")
    if not isinstance(checks, dict):
        problems.append("checks is not an object")
    else:
        for name in preflight._BLOCKING_CHECKS:
            probe = checks.get(name)
            if not isinstance(probe, dict) or probe.get("status") != preflight.STATUS_OK:
                problems.append(f"checks.{name}.status is not ok")
        budget_root = (checks.get("trace_budget") or {}).get("output_root")
        budget_sha = (checks.get("trace_budget") or {}).get("budget_sha256")
        if expected_budget_sha256 is not None and budget_sha != expected_budget_sha256:
            problems.append(
                f"preflight budget_sha256={budget_sha!r} != "
                f"{expected_budget_sha256!r}"
            )
        try:
            observed_root = Path(budget_root).resolve() if budget_root else None
        except OSError:
            observed_root = None
        if observed_root != expected_output_root.resolve():
                problems.append(
                    f"preflight budget output_root={budget_root!r} does not bind "
                    f"capture root {str(expected_output_root)!r}"
                )
        injection = checks.get("injection_runtime") or {}
        coverage_status, coverage_detail = preflight.full_trace_coverage_verdict(
            root_launch_count=injection.get("root_trace_launch_count"),
            grid_threadblocks=injection.get("grid_threadblock_count"),
            decoded_threadblocks=injection.get("decoded_threadblock_count"),
            threadblock_pb_count=injection.get("threadblocks_pb_count"),
            decoded_records=injection.get("decoded_record_count"),
            expected_records=injection.get("expected_insts"),
            admitted_records=injection.get("admitted_insts"),
            stats_row_count=injection.get("stats_row_count"),
            sampling_sidecar_present=injection.get("sampling_sidecar_present"),
            zero_record_threadblocks=injection.get(
                "zero_record_threadblock_count"),
        )
        if coverage_status != preflight.STATUS_OK:
            problems.append(
                f"preflight full-coverage evidence is contradictory: {coverage_detail}"
            )
        sol_check = checks.get("sol_environment") or {}
        if expected_matrix_sha256 is not None:
            if sol_check.get("matrix_sha256") != expected_matrix_sha256:
                problems.append(
                    "preflight SOL environment matrix hash does not match"
                )
            observed = sol_check.get("observed_fingerprint") or {}
            if (
                observed.get("degraded") is not False
                or observed.get("missing") != []
            ):
                problems.append("preflight SOL environment is degraded")
            compiler = sol_check.get("compiler_identity") or {}
            if compiler.get("requested") != "g++-14":
                problems.append("preflight SOL compiler is not literal g++-14")
        if expected_sol_fingerprint_pin is not None:
            if sol_check.get("matrix_pin") != expected_sol_fingerprint_pin:
                problems.append(
                    "preflight SOL fingerprint pin does not match matrix"
                )
            observed = sol_check.get("observed_fingerprint") or {}
            if observed.get("hash") != expected_sol_fingerprint_pin.get(
                "native_env_hash"
            ):
                problems.append(
                    "preflight SOL fingerprint does not match certified hash"
                )
    if problems:
        raise ChunkRefusal("preflight_invalid", "; ".join(problems))
    generated = _parse_utc_timestamp(
        generated_raw, field="generated_at_utc"
    )
    if not require_fresh:
        return
    admitted = admitted_at_utc or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    if admitted.tzinfo is None:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "preflight_invalid", "admitted_at_utc has no timezone"
        )
    admitted = admitted.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    future_s = (generated - admitted).total_seconds()
    if future_s > preflight.PREFLIGHT_FUTURE_SKEW_SECONDS:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "PREFLIGHT_CLOCK_SKEW",
            f"generated_at_utc is {future_s:.3f}s after admission; "
            f"maximum={preflight.PREFLIGHT_FUTURE_SKEW_SECONDS:.3f}s",
        )
    age_s = (admitted - generated).total_seconds()
    if age_s > preflight.PREFLIGHT_FRESHNESS_SECONDS:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "PREFLIGHT_EXPIRED",
            f"preflight age {age_s:.3f}s exceeds inclusive "
            f"{preflight.PREFLIGHT_FRESHNESS_SECONDS:.3f}s window",
        )


def validate_live_injection_hashes(manifest: dict, pins: dict) -> None:
    probe = (manifest.get("checks") or {}).get("injection_runtime") or {}
    inj = pins.get("injection_runtime") or {}
    tracer = _resolve_repo_path(inj.get("tracer_so_relpath"), "tracer .so")
    smoke = _resolve_repo_path(inj.get("smoke_binary_relpath"), "smoke binary")
    mismatches = []
    for role, path, field in (
        ("tracer .so", tracer, "tracer_so_sha256"),
        ("smoke binary", smoke, "smoke_binary_sha256"),
    ):
        actual = sha256_file(path)
        if probe.get(field) != actual:
            mismatches.append(
                f"{role}: preflight={probe.get(field)!r}, current={actual}"
            )
    if mismatches:
        raise ChunkRefusal("injection_runtime_hash_drift", "; ".join(mismatches))


def _matrix_cells_by_identity(matrix: dict) -> dict[tuple[str, str], dict]:
    cells = matrix.get("cells")
    if not isinstance(cells, list) or not cells:
        raise ChunkRefusal("matrix_empty", "matrix cells must be a nonempty list")
    out: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = {}
    for index, cell in enumerate(cells):
        identity = cell.get("identity") if isinstance(cell, dict) else None
        key = (
            identity.get("roster_source") if isinstance(identity, dict) else None,
            identity.get("slug") if isinstance(identity, dict) else None,
        )
        if not all(isinstance(part, str) and part for part in key):
            raise ChunkRefusal("matrix_identity_invalid", f"cells[{index}]={key!r}")
        if key in out:
            raise ChunkRefusal("matrix_identity_duplicate", repr(key))
        out[key] = cell
    return out


def select_chunk(matrix: dict, chunk_id: str) -> tuple[dict, list[dict]]:
    chunks = matrix.get("chunks")
    if not isinstance(chunks, list) or not chunks:
        raise ChunkRefusal("matrix_chunks_empty", "matrix chunks must be nonempty")
    selected = [row for row in chunks if row.get("chunk_id") == chunk_id]
    if len(selected) != 1:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "chunk_identity_invalid", f"chunk_id {chunk_id!r} matched {len(selected)} rows"
        )
    chunk = selected[0]
    members = chunk.get("cells")
    if not isinstance(members, list) or not members:
        raise ChunkRefusal("chunk_empty", f"chunk {chunk_id!r} has no members")
    expected_membership = canonical_sha256(members)
    if chunk.get("membership_sha256") != expected_membership:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "chunk_membership_hash_mismatch",
            f"expected {expected_membership}, got {chunk.get('membership_sha256')}",
        )
    cells_by_id = _matrix_cells_by_identity(matrix)
    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    resolved: list[dict] = []
    for index, member in enumerate(members):
        if not isinstance(member, dict):
            raise ChunkRefusal("chunk_member_invalid", f"cells[{index}] is not an object")
        key = (member.get("roster_source"), member.get("slug"))
        if key in seen:
            raise ChunkRefusal("chunk_member_duplicate", repr(key))
        seen.add(key)
        if key not in cells_by_id:
            raise ChunkRefusal("chunk_member_absent", repr(key))
        cell = cells_by_id[key]
        if cell.get("disposition") != "runnable":
            raise ChunkRefusal("chunk_member_not_runnable", repr(key))
        readiness = cell.get("capture_readiness") or {}
        if readiness.get("status") != "ready" or readiness.get("blocking_reasons") not in ([], None):
            raise ChunkRefusal(
                "chunk_member_not_ready", f"{key!r}: {readiness!r}"
            )
        resolved.append(cell)
    return chunk, resolved


def validate_matrix_inputs(
    matrix: dict, *, matrix_path: Path, authority_path: Path, pins_path: Path,
    aggregate_budget_path: Path, cell_budget_path: Path, registry_path: Path,
    bound_metric_registry: BoundMetricRegistry,
) -> dict:
    try:
        import jsonschema
        jsonschema.validate(matrix, json.loads(MATRIX_SCHEMA.read_text()))
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ChunkRefusal("matrix_schema_invalid", str(exc)) from exc

    source_commit = matrix.get("source_commit")
    if not _is_sha40(source_commit):
        raise ChunkRefusal("matrix_source_commit_invalid", repr(source_commit))
    unsealed = {key: value for key, value in matrix.items()
                if key != "matrix_seal_sha256"}
    derived_matrix_seal = canonical_sha256(unsealed)
    if matrix.get("matrix_seal_sha256") != derived_matrix_seal:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "matrix_seal_mismatch",
            f"expected {derived_matrix_seal}, got {matrix.get('matrix_seal_sha256')}",
        )
    if not isinstance(bound_metric_registry, BoundMetricRegistry):
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "matrix_metric_registry_binding_invalid",
            repr(bound_metric_registry),
        )
    semantic_problems = rederive_capture_matrix(
        matrix,
        REPO_ROOT,
        registry_document=bound_metric_registry.document,
        registry_payload=bound_metric_registry.snapshot.payload,
        registry_sha256=bound_metric_registry.snapshot.sha256,
    )
    if semantic_problems:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "matrix_semantic_rederivation_failed", "; ".join(semantic_problems)
        )

    authority_pin = matrix.get("authority") or {}
    pin_group = matrix.get("input_pins") or {}
    expected = (
        (authority_path, authority_pin, "authority"),
        (pins_path, pin_group.get("protocol_pins") or {}, "protocol pins"),
        (aggregate_budget_path, pin_group.get("aggregate_retention_budget") or {},
         "aggregate retention budget"),
        (cell_budget_path, pin_group.get("per_cell_trace_budgets") or {},
         "per-cell trace budgets"),
        (registry_path, pin_group.get("metric_registry") or {}, "metric registry"),
    )
    for actual_path, pin, role in expected:
        if role == "metric registry":
            if (
                not isinstance(bound_metric_registry, BoundMetricRegistry)
                or bound_metric_registry.snapshot.path
                != _lexical_absolute_path(actual_path)
                or bound_metric_registry.snapshot.sha256 != pin.get("sha256")
            ):
                raise ChunkRefusal(
                    "matrix_metric_registry_binding_invalid",
                    f"path={actual_path}; pin={pin!r}",
                )
            # bind_matrix_metric_registry already performed the sole anchored
            # read, exact-byte hash, strict parse, and registry validation.
            continue
        if pin.get("path"):
            pinned_path = _resolve_repo_path(pin["path"], role)
            if pinned_path != actual_path.resolve():
                raise ChunkRefusal(
                    "input_path_mismatch",
                    f"{role}: matrix={pinned_path}, CLI={actual_path.resolve()}",
                )
        _require_hash(actual_path, pin.get("sha256"), role)

    if (pin_group.get("per_cell_trace_budgets") or {}).get(
        "defaults_are_enforcement"
    ) is not False:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "budget_defaults_ambiguous", "matrix must pin defaults_are_enforcement=false"
        )

    authority = _json(authority_path)
    if authority.get("source_commit") != source_commit:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "authority_source_commit_mismatch",
            f"{authority.get('source_commit')!r} != {source_commit!r}",
        )
    authority_rows: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = {}
    for row in authority.get("cells") or []:
        key = (row.get("roster_source"), row.get("slug"))
        if key in authority_rows:
            raise ChunkRefusal("authority_identity_duplicate", repr(key))
        authority_rows[key] = row
    for key, cell in _matrix_cells_by_identity(matrix).items():
        row = authority_rows.get(key)
        if row is None:
            raise ChunkRefusal("matrix_authority_member_absent", repr(key))
        actual_row_hash = canonical_sha256(row)
        if cell.get("authority_cell_sha256") != actual_row_hash:
            raise ChunkRefusal(
                "authority_cell_hash_mismatch", f"{key!r}: {actual_row_hash}"
            )
    if set(authority_rows) != set(_matrix_cells_by_identity(matrix)):
        raise ChunkRefusal("matrix_authority_set_mismatch", "identity sets differ")
    return authority


def _forwarded_nonnegative_int_flag(args: Any, flag: str) -> int | None:
    """Parse zero or one exact integer flag without accepting ambiguity."""
    if not isinstance(args, list) or not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in args):
        raise ChunkRefusal("invocation_args_invalid", flag)
    values: list[str] = []
    index = 0
    while index < len(args):
        token = args[index]
        if token == flag:
            if index + 1 >= len(args):
                raise ChunkRefusal("invocation_flag_invalid", f"{flag}: missing value")
            values.append(args[index + 1])
            index += 2
            continue
        if token.startswith(f"{flag}="):
            values.append(token.split("=", 1)[1])
        index += 1
    if len(values) > 1:
        raise ChunkRefusal("invocation_flag_invalid", f"{flag}: duplicate")
    if not values:
        return None
    if not values[0].isdigit():
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "invocation_flag_invalid", f"{flag}: non-negative integer required"
        )
    return int(values[0])


def _require_capture_launch_contract(invocation: dict) -> dict:
    contract = invocation.get("capture_launch_contract")
    if isinstance(contract, dict) and contract.get("schema_version") == 2:
        expected = {
            "schema_version": 2,
            "label_driver_warmup_count": 1,
            "label_effective_warmup_count": 0,
            "label_launch_index": 0,
            "label_measured_reps": 1,
            "trace_candidate_call_count": 1,
            "trace_dynamic_launch_scope": "all_in_profiler_roi",
            "trace_dynamic_launch_count_source": "runtime_inventory",
        }
        if contract != expected:
            raise ChunkRefusal(
                "capture_launch_contract_invalid", repr(contract)
            )
        return contract
    base_fields = {
        "schema_version", "label_driver_warmup_count",
        "label_effective_warmup_count", "label_launch_index",
        "label_measured_reps", "trace_launch_count",
        "label_trace_launch_index",
    }
    if not isinstance(contract, dict) or frozenset(contract) not in {
        frozenset(base_fields), frozenset(base_fields | {"trace_launch_sequence"}),
    }:
        raise ChunkRefusal("capture_launch_contract_invalid", repr(contract))
    integer_fields = base_fields - {"schema_version"}
    if contract.get("schema_version") != 1 or any(
        type(contract.get(field)) is not int or contract[field] < 0
        for field in integer_fields
    ):
        raise ChunkRefusal("capture_launch_contract_invalid", repr(contract))
    if contract["label_measured_reps"] != 1:
        raise ChunkRefusal("capture_launch_contract_invalid", repr(contract))
    expected_count = contract["trace_launch_count"]
    if expected_count not in {1, 3}:
        raise ChunkRefusal("capture_launch_contract_invalid", repr(contract))
    if contract["label_trace_launch_index"] >= expected_count:
        raise ChunkRefusal("capture_launch_contract_invalid", repr(contract))
    sequence = contract.get("trace_launch_sequence")
    if expected_count == 1 and sequence is not None:
        raise ChunkRefusal("capture_launch_contract_invalid", repr(contract))
    if expected_count == 3:
        required_rows = [
            {
                "device_id": 0, "stream_id": 0, "kernel_id": 1,
                "kernel_name": "warm_cold_pair_kernel___0",
                "grid_dim": [32, 1, 1], "block_dim": [32, 1, 1],
                "role": "cold",
            },
            {
                "device_id": 0, "stream_id": 0, "kernel_id": 2,
                "kernel_name": "warm_cold_pair_eviction_kernel___0",
                "grid_dim": [32, 1, 1], "block_dim": [32, 1, 1],
                "role": "evict",
            },
            {
                "device_id": 0, "stream_id": 0, "kernel_id": 3,
                "kernel_name": "warm_cold_pair_kernel___0",
                "grid_dim": [32, 1, 1], "block_dim": [32, 1, 1],
                "role": "warm",
            },
        ]
        if sequence != required_rows:
            raise ChunkRefusal("capture_launch_contract_invalid", repr(contract))
    label_args = invocation.get("label_app_args")
    forwarded_warmup = _forwarded_nonnegative_int_flag(label_args, "--warmup")
    if forwarded_warmup is None:
        logical_shape = (invocation.get("logical_workload") or {}).get("value")
        effective_warmup = (
            contract["label_driver_warmup_count"]
            if invocation.get("shape_delivery") == "application_args"
            and logical_shape in {"correctness_shape", "timing_shape"}
            else 0
        )
    else:
        effective_warmup = forwarded_warmup
        if forwarded_warmup != contract["label_driver_warmup_count"]:
            raise ChunkRefusal("capture_launch_contract_invalid", repr(contract))
    if effective_warmup != contract["label_effective_warmup_count"]:
        raise ChunkRefusal("capture_launch_contract_invalid", repr(contract))
    forwarded_reps = _forwarded_nonnegative_int_flag(label_args, "--reps")
    if forwarded_reps is not None and forwarded_reps != 1:
        raise ChunkRefusal("capture_launch_contract_invalid", repr(contract))
    return contract


def _validate_trace_launch_contract(invocation: dict, root: dict) -> None:
    contract = _require_capture_launch_contract(invocation)
    expected_count = contract["trace_launch_count"]
    launches = root.get("launches")
    if root.get("launch_count") != expected_count or not isinstance(launches, list) \
            or len(launches) != expected_count:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "trace_launch_cardinality_invalid",
            f"expected {expected_count} selected launch(es), observed "
            f"{root.get('launch_count')!r}",
        )
    expected_sequence = contract.get("trace_launch_sequence")
    if expected_sequence is not None:
        comparable = [
            {key: launch.get(key) for key in (
                "device_id", "stream_id", "kernel_id", "kernel_name",
                "grid_dim", "block_dim",
            )}
            for launch in launches
        ]
        expected_comparable = [
            {key: launch[key] for key in (
                "device_id", "stream_id", "kernel_id", "kernel_name",
                "grid_dim", "block_dim",
            )}
            for launch in expected_sequence
        ]
        if comparable != expected_comparable:
            raise ChunkRefusal(
                "trace_launch_sequence_invalid",
                f"expected={expected_comparable!r}, observed={comparable!r}",
            )


def validate_direct_cell(cell: dict, *, cell_budgets: Any) -> tuple[Path, dict, Any]:
    identity = cell["identity"]
    invocation = cell.get("invocation") or {}
    adapter_kind = invocation.get("adapter_kind")
    if adapter_kind not in _DIRECT_ADAPTERS:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "adapter_not_implemented",
            f"{identity}: adapter_kind={adapter_kind!r} is not a direct executable",
        )
    binary = _resolve_repo_path(invocation.get("executable_path"), "cell executable")
    if not binary.is_file() or not os.access(binary, os.X_OK):
        raise ChunkRefusal("cell_executable_unavailable", str(binary))
    _require_hash(binary, invocation.get("executable_sha256"), "cell executable")
    for field in ("label_app_args", "trace_app_args"):
        args = invocation.get(field)
        if not isinstance(args, list) or not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in args):
            raise ChunkRefusal("invocation_args_invalid", f"{identity}: {field}")
    _require_capture_launch_contract(invocation)
    budget = require_cell_budget(cell_budgets, identity["slug"])
    matrix_budget = cell.get("trace_budget") or {}
    for field in ("max_trace_bytes", "max_wall_time_s", "sampling_policy"):
        if matrix_budget.get(field) != getattr(budget, field):
            raise ChunkRefusal(
                "cell_budget_mismatch",
                f"{identity}: matrix {field}={matrix_budget.get(field)!r} != "
                f"config {getattr(budget, field)!r}",
            )
    control = cell.get("control_bits") or {}
    expected_control_policy = (
        "post_trace_vendor_module"
        if identity.get("roster_source") == "simbench_bw"
        and identity.get("slug") in _VENDOR_RUNTIME_CONTROL_SLUGS
        else "direct_executable"
    )
    if control.get("policy") != expected_control_policy:
        raise ChunkRefusal(
            "control_policy_not_implemented", f"{identity}: {control.get('policy')!r}"
        )
    if (
        expected_control_policy == "direct_executable"
        and control.get("input_sha256") != invocation.get("executable_sha256")
    ):
        raise ChunkRefusal("control_binary_mismatch", repr(identity))
    return binary, invocation, budget


def _workload_row_count(path: Path) -> int:
    """Count the exact non-comment JSONL rows the SOL adapter consumes."""
    count = 0
